sa: श्चकार तस्मिन् हरिवीरमुख्ये। अवध्यतां तस्य कपेः समीक्ष्य कथं निगच्छेदिति निग्रहार्थम्॥
en: Thereupon, that son of the lord of Rākşasas pinned his thoughts upon that foremost of monkeys, and finding him incapable of being slain, he began to devise plans how he could be bound.

sa: तस्याः स वैदूर्यमयं प्रियकाजिनसंवृतम्॥ महत्सोपाश्रयं भेजे रावणः परमासनम्। ततः शशासेश्वरहूताल्लघुपराक्रमान्॥
en: Rävaņa sat down on a superb and august seat consisting of lapises, furnished with a pillow; and covered with a soft dear-skin. And lord-like he commanded the envoys possessed of fleet vigour, saying.

sa: हिताश्च शूराश्च समाहिताश्च कलेषु जाताश्च महागुणेषु। मनस्विनः शस्त्रभृतां वरिष्ठाः कोपप्रशस्ताः सुभृताश्च सुभृताश्च योधाः॥ तदेकदेशेन बलस्य तावत् केचित् तवादेशकृतोऽद्य यान्तु। तौ राजपुत्रावुपगृह्य मूढौ परेषु ते भावयितुं प्रभावम्॥ निशाचराणामधिपोऽनुजस्य विभीषणस्योत्तमवाक्यनिष्ठम्। महाबलो राक्षसराजमुख्यः॥
en: They are devoted to your good, and are heroic and intent on your well-being, born in lines having high and fiery virtues, and endowed with intelligence, the flower of those bearing arms—and have been maintained by you. Therefore let a portion of the forces, having received your order, march to-day, and bring (hither) those foolish princes. It is meet that you should display your prowess before fores.” Thereat, the lord of the night-rangers, that potent enemy of the celestials and the foremost of Räkşasa monarchs, lending free play to his intellect, accepted the excellent words of his younger brother.

sa: प्रसन्नाः सुरसाश्चापो वनानि फलवन्ति च। प्रवान्ति नाधिका गन्धा यथर्तुकुसुमा दुमाः॥
en: The water is dear and tastes sweet; and the woods are stocked with fruit. And the odorous gale does not blow strongly; and the trees are furnished with all blossoms of the season.

sa: सारथिः स रथं हृष्टः परसैन्यप्रधर्षणम्। गन्धर्वनगराकारं समुच्छ्रितपताकिनाम्॥ युक्तं परमसंपत्नैर्वाजिभिहेममालिभिः। युद्धोपकरणैः पूर्णं पताकाध्वजमालिनम्॥ असन्तमिव चाकाशं नादयन्तं वसुंधराम्। प्रणाशं परसैन्यानां स्वसैन्यस्य प्रहर्षणम्॥
en: Then the charioteer fully drove with speed Rāvaņa's car, capable of bringing down the hosts of foes, resembling in form a city of the Gandharvas having elevated streamers, yoked with surpassingly superb steeds, engarlanded in gold: stocked with war-like implements; furnished with ensigns and standards; appearing to devour the welkin; making the earth herself resound; destructive to hostile host; and filling its own party with delight.

sa: प्रियान्न सम्भवेद् दुःखमप्रियादधिकं भवेत्। ताभ्यां हि ते वियुज्यन्ते नमस्तेषां महात्मनाम्॥
en: They are not distressed with misery for their objects of love or grief for them whom they do not love. They are freed from them and I do bow to those high-souled ones.

sa: विपुलांसो महाबाहुः कम्बुग्रीवः शुभाननः। गूढजत्रुः सुताम्राक्षो रामो नाम जनैः श्रुतः॥
en: He is broad-shouldered, large-armed, has a conch-like neck and a beautiful countenance. His throat is plump and his eyes are red-and he is famed all over the world under the name of Rāma.

sa: असौ पुनर्व्याकरणं ग्रहीष्यन् सूर्योन्मुखः प्रष्टुमना कपीन्द्रः। उद्यद्गिरेरस्तगिरिं जगाम ग्रन्थं महद्धारयनप्रमेयः॥
en: Having curiosity to learn grammar, the best of Mongols of immeasurable power went towards the hill of rising Sun facing Sunward with the view to ask queries and to master the great work.

sa: पतिशोकातुरां शुष्कां नदी विस्रावितामिव। परया मृजया हीनां कृष्णपक्षे निशामिव ॥
en: And her grace greatly famished by the absence of her husband she appeared like a river whose liquid contents were dried up. And not cleaning her limbs she appeared like a dark night.

sa: इत्युक्तस्तु सुरैः सर्वैः कपर्दी नीललोहितः। सुकेशं प्रति सापेक्षः प्राह देवगणान्प्रभुः॥
en: Thus addressed by the immortals in a body, that lord, Kaparddi of red-blue hue, reflecting that it would be wrong for him to destroy Sukesa (with his own hands), spoke to the gods.

sa: चपलस्य तु कृत्येषु प्रसमीक्ष्याधिकं बलम्। छिद्रमन्ये प्रपद्यन्ते क्रौञ्चस्य खमिव द्विजाः॥
en: Others spy holes in the actions of the volatile, the latter may be possessed of great power, like swans passing Krauñca through the hole. * *The hole made by the dart of Kumāra.

sa: सा पुरा सुखसंवृद्धा सुखार्हा दुःखकर्षिता। त्वय्यधीनं सुखं ज्ञात्वा सर्वथैव गमिष्यति॥
en: Having formerly been brought up in happiness, she, although worthy of felicity, (ultimately) had come by misfortune. And now finding happiness to be in your custody, she shall unreservedly come over to you.

sa: सर्वाः सेना निवेश्यन्तां वेलायां हरिपुङ्गव। संप्राप्तो मन्त्रकालो नः सागरस्येह लङ्घने॥
en: O foremost of monkeys, do you encamp your host on the bring of the ocean. Now has arrived the hour for counsel, when we should devise some plan for crossing over the main.

sa: स्वप्नो ह्यद्य मया दृष्टो दारुणो रोमहर्षणः। राक्षसानामभावाय भर्तुरस्या भवाय च॥
en: I dreamt a terrible dream last night which made my down stand on their end. And in that dream I foresaw the overthrow of the Rāksasa race and the conquest of her husband.

sa: यतो न गुरुरप्येनं श्रावयेदुपपादयेत्। तं विद्याद् ब्रह्मणो योगं वियोग योगसंज्ञितम्॥
en: Communion with Brahma cannot be taught to us even by our spiritual preceptor; he can only give us a clue to the mystery; renunciation of things of the material world is called Yoga.

sa: न हि सम्बुध्यते यावत् सुप्तः सिंह इवाच्युतः। तेन सिंहीकरोत्येतान् नृसिंहश्चेदिपुङ्गवः॥
en: Achyuta (Krishna) is now like a lion that is asleep. So long he does not wake up this king of the Chedis, this foremost of men, makes these monarchs look like the lions.

sa: विजित्य पृथिवीं सर्वां मोदमानः सुखी भव। एषे भूतो भविष्यच्चधर्मस्ते समुदीरितः॥
en: Conquering all the world, remain in joy and be happy. This is the course of conduct that accords with the rules of virtue. This is and this was what is considered as virtue.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच उपस्पृश्येह विधिवदस्यां नद्यां तपोबलात्। मानुषादस्मि विषयादपेतः पश्य लोमश॥
en: Yudhishthira said : O Lomasha, behold, how great is the merit of a pious act! Having bathed in this spot with proper form, I seem no more to touch the world of men.

sa: दृष्टं ह्येतद् विदुरेणैव सर्वं विपश्चिता बुद्धिविद्यानुगेन। तदेवैतदवशस्याभ्युपैति महद् भयं क्षत्रियजीवधाति॥
en: All this has been foreseen by the learned Vidura, who follows the path of learning end wisdom. the great calamity which would cause the destruction of the Kshatriya-lives comes as willed by Fate.

sa: स्त्वष्टारमागम्य तमर्षमूचुः। त्वष्टा तु तेषां वचनं निशम्य प्रहृष्टरूपः प्रयतः प्रयत्नात्॥
en: Then the celestials with glad heart went to Tvashtri (Vishwakarma) and told him the means of their victory. Tyashtri also hearing their words was filled with joy; and with great attention and care.

sa: यत् तद् ब्रह्मशिरो नाम तपसा रुद्रमागमत्। अमृतादुत्थितं रौद्रं तल्लब्धं सव्यसाचिना॥
en: That fearful weapon, known by the name of Brahinashira which rose after the Ambrosia (in the churning of the ocean) and which Rudra obtained after great asceticism, has been obtained by Savyasachi (Arjuna).

sa: ततस्तदाज्ञाय मतं महात्मा यथावदुक्तं पुरुषोत्तमेन। प्रशस्य विप्रेक्ष्य चधर्मराजः कृताञ्जलि: केशवमित्युवाचः॥
en: Then the high-souled Dharmaraja, being informed of the views thus clearly expressed by that best of men and praising the same and looking at Krishna spoke these words with joined hands to him.

sa: इन्द्र उवाच चिकित्सको कर्मकरी कामरूपसमन्वितौ। लोके चरन्तौ मानां कथं सोममिहार्हतः॥
en: Indra said: These two are physicians and as such they are but servants. Assuming various forms at pleasure, they roam about the world of the mortals. How can they claim the Soma juice?

sa: ततो जवेनाभिससार रोषाद् दुःशासनस्तामभिगर्जमानः। दीर्येषु नीलेष्वथ चोर्मिमत्सु जग्राह केशेषु नरेन्द्रपत्नीम्॥
en: The hair that was (once) sprinkled with the water sanctified with Mantras in the great Rajasuya sacrifice were now forcibly seized by the son of Dhritarashtra who disregarded the prowess of the Pandavas.

sa: महच्छत्रुहणं घोरं षडधे भीमनिःस्वनम्। तेन वज्रेण वै वृत्रं वधिष्यति शतक्रतुः॥
en: It will have six sides, it will be fearful, it will make terrible roars, it will be able to destroy even the greatest enemies . With that Vajra, Shatakratu (Indra) will kill Vitra.

sa: असंतोषस्य नास्त्यन्तस्तुष्टिस्तु परमं सुखम्। न शोचन्ति गताध्वानः पश्यन्तः परमां गतिम्॥ न विषादे मनः कार्यं विषादो विषमुत्तमम्। मारयत्यकृतप्रज्ञं बालं क्रुद्ध इवोरगः॥
en: There is not end to to discontent and contentment is the highest happiness. The man who has attained the highest state does not grieve. They are always conscious of the final destruction of all creatures. One must not give way to discontent, for it is like a virulently poisonous snake. It kills persons of undeveloped intelligence just as a child is killed by an enraged snake.

sa: नगरी संजयन्ती च पाखण्डं करहाटकम्। दूतैरेव वशे चक्रे करं चैनानदापयत्॥
en: The son of Pandu also subjugated the city of Sanjayanti and the country of the Pakhandas and Karahatakas by means of his messengers alone; and he made them all pay tribute to him.

sa: स त्वर्यमाणो बहुश ऋतुपर्णेन बाहुकः। अश्वाञ्जिज्ञासमानो वै विचार्य च पुनः पुनः। अभ्यगच्छत् कृशानश्वान् समर्थानध्वनि क्षमान्॥ तेजोबलसमायुक्तान् कुलशीलसमन्वितान्। वर्जिताँल्लक्षणैर्हनिः पृथुप्रोथान् महाहनून्॥
en: Bahuka, having been repeatedly asked by Rituparna, examined the horses and balanced in his mind over and over again. Then, at last, he selected such horses that were very lean but able; and also that are capable of bearing hardhips of a long journey and endued with strength and energy; well bred and gentle and unmarked by inauspicious marks; possessed of broad nostrils and swelling cheeks.

sa: आत्मार्थं युध्यमानानां विदिते कृत्यलक्षणे। अन्यैरपि हृते राज्ये प्रशंसैव न गर्हणा॥
en: Our kingdom having been robbed from us, if we (under the circumstances) engage in a war, our that act, when it well be known in the world, will bring praise and no condemnation.

sa: अविशेषेण तस्याहं कुर्यां धर्मं द्विजोत्तम्। शुश्रूषायाः फलं पश्य यत्युाह्मण यादृशम्॥
en: the most excellent of the Brahmanas, I cultivate that special virtue viz., the serving of my husband as the highest god. O Brahmana, you observe what results from the worship of one's husband.

sa: मुहुरुत्पतते बाला मुहुः पतति विह्वला। मुहुरालीयते भीता मुहुः क्रोशति रोदिति॥
en: At times the youthful princess would stand up suddenly. At other times she would sink down bewildered. Now she would conceal herself alarmed and the next moment, she would cry and wail aloud.

sa: हिंस्यात् क्रोधादवध्यांस्तु वध्यान् सम्पूजयीत च आत्मानमपि च क्रुद्धः प्रेषयेद् यमसादनम्॥
en: From anger a man may kill one who should not be killed and adore one that should be slain, an angry man may even dispatch his own self to the abode of Yama.

sa: निकृत्या कामये नाहं सुखान्युत धनानि वा। कितवस्येह कृतिनो वृत्तमेतन्न पूज्यते॥
en: I do not desire to have happiness or wealth by means of cunning. The conduct of one that is a gamester, even if his playing be without deceitfulness, should still never be praised.

sa: विदर्भराण्मम पिता भर्ता राजा च नैषधः। नलो नाम महाभागस्तं मृग्याम्यपराजितम्॥
en: The sovereign of Vidharbhas is my father, the illustrious Ruler of the Nishadhas is my husband, known under the name of Nala. Even now I am wandering in quest of that unconquerable one.

sa: सरय्वां जनयत् सिद्धिं भानु भाभिः समावृणोत्। आग्नेयमानयन् नित्यमाह्वाने ह्येष सूयते॥
en: He begot a son on his wife Sarayu named Siddhi and covered the Sun with his splendour. As he is the presiding genius of fire, he is always mentioned in all fire hymn.

sa: कश्चित् कर्माणि कुर्वन् हि न प्राप्यमधिगच्छति। देवानिष्ट्वा तपस्तप्त्वा कृपणैः पुत्रगृद्धिभिः॥
en: There are other again who with the greatest exertion are unable to obtain what is their own dues. The miserly persons with the object of having sons worship the celestials and perform asceticism.

sa: अद्यैव ते सम्प्रयाताः समैर्वर्त्मभिरस्थलैः। गुणज्येष्ठास्तथा श्रेष्ठाः श्रेयांसो यद् वयं परैः॥
en: The gods are propitious to us, whether or not we have proceeded in the very narrow path (of sin); for we are today superior to our enemy in wealth and in every thing.

sa: तमुग्रमास्थाय तपश्चरन्तं शुश्राव रामश्च जनार्दनश्च। तौ सर्ववृष्णिप्रवरौ ससैन्यौ युधिष्ठिरं जग्मतुराजमीढम्॥
en: When he was thus practising the severe austerities, Rama and Janardana (Balarama and Krishna) heard of it. The two leaders of the Vrishnis accompanied with soldiers went to Yudhishthira, the descendant of Ajamidha.

sa: एवं प्रणिहितं भीम चिरात् प्रभृति मे मनः। द्रष्टुमिच्छामि शैलाचं त्वद्वाहुबलपालिता।॥
en: O Bhima, I have cherished this thought in my mind for a long time, and I have a mind to behold the summit of this mountain protected by the force of your arms.

sa: स्वधर्म प्रतिपद्यस्व जहि शत्रून् समागतान्। धार्तराष्ट्रवनं पार्थ मया पार्थेन नाशय॥
en: Therefore, O son of Pritha, perform the duty of your own (order) and destroy the enemies. Destroy the prowess of the sons of Dhritarashtra with my help and with that of Partha (Arjuna).

sa: राजोवाच वडवे इव संयुक्ते श्येनपाते दिवौकसाम्। कस्तयोर्गर्भमाधत्ते गर्भं सुषुवतुश्च कम्॥
en: The King said : Who among the celestials gives birth to those who which go together like two yoked mares and swoop down like hawks; and to what also do they give birth?

sa: तामुवाच ततो राजा वेपमानां कृताञ्जलिम्। दौत्येनागत्य कल्याणि तथा भद्रे विधीयताम्॥
en: The king, who had come on the mission of the gods, answered her thus who was trembling (with fear), standing with joined hands, 'O blessed one, O gentle one, do what you please.

sa: यवक्रीत उवाच द्विजानामनधीत वै वेदाः सुरगणार्चित। प्रतिभान्त्विति तप्येऽहमिदं परमकं तपः॥
en: Yavakrit said : O worshipped of the celestials, I am engaged in the severe asceticism, because I desire to possess such knowledge of the Vedas as has never been acquired by any Brahmana.

sa: कर्तृत्वादेव पुरुषः कर्मसिद्धौ प्रशस्यते। असिद्धौ निन्द्यते चापि कर्मनाशात् कथं त्विह॥
en: It is because a person is himself the instrument of his action that he is praised when or he acquires success, so the doer is censured when he is unsuccessful; nothing else exists.

sa: तंधर्मराजो विमना इवाब्रवीत् सर्वे ह्रिया सन्ति तपस्विनोऽमी। स्तपस्विनां पश्यतां मामुदीक्ष्य॥
en: The pious Yudhishthira who was beside himself (with grief) said, “All these ascetics are sorry for seeing me here; why is it that you alone smile, as if in delight, before all these?"

sa: रेतेन संख्ये निहतोऽश्वचक्रः। को नाम साम्बस्य महारथस्य रणे समक्षं रथमभ्युदयात्॥
en: Ashvachakra whose thighs were round and whose mascular arms were of exceeding length was killed by him in battle. Who is there who can go before the car of the great car-warrior Samba?

sa: श्रीभगवानुवाच ऊर्ध्वमूलमधःशाखमश्वत्थं प्राहुरव्ययम्। छन्दांसि यस्य पर्णानि यस्तं वेद स वेदवित्॥
en: The great One said They say that the Ahsvatha tree with its roots above and branches below is (like the) eternal. Its leaves are the Chandas. He who knows it knows the Vedas.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच अधर्मयुक्तैर्बहुभिः परिवार्य महारथैः। युध्यमानो महेष्वासः सौभद्रो निहतो रणे॥
en: Yudhisthira said The son of Subhadra has been slain in battle when fighting with many, by several fierce bowmen of vicious tendencies, who, mighty car-warriors as they were, surrounded him on all sides.

sa: संजय उवाच महद् भैरवमानीन्नः संनिवृत्तेषु पाण्डुषु। दृष्ट्वा द्रोणं छाद्यमानं तैर्भास्करमिवाम्बुदैः॥
en: Sanjaya said When the Pandava host returned to the battle, a mighty apprehension took possession of ourselves covered (by the arrows) like the lustrous rob covered over by a continuous) mass of rain-clouds.

sa: सा वत्सभूमि कौरव्य तीर्थलोभात् ततस्ततः। पतिता परिधावन्ती पुनः काशिपतेः सुता॥
en: And the daughter of the king of Kashi, o Kauravya, on account of her love of pilgrimage came to Vatsabhumi, and there she fell down and began to run down (as a river.)

sa: स गाढविद्धो व्यथितो रथोपस्थ उपाविशत्। भृशं क्रोधेन चाविष्टो रथस्थो राक्षसाधिपः॥
en: That one (Brihadbala) thus deeply pierced and smarting with pain, sat down on the terrace of his chariot. Then that lord of the Rakshasas possessed with furious wrath, and stationed on his car,

sa: तर्जयानं रणे वीरांस्त्रासयानं च सायकैः। दृष्ट्वा त्रेसुर्महाराज सिंहं मृगगणा इव॥
en: Beholding him utter loud war-cries in battle and frighten heroes with his shafts. O monarch, the Pandava warriors were seized with terror, like a herd of deer at the sight of a lion.

sa: किं पुनस्त्वयि दुर्धर्षे सैनापत्ये व्यवस्थिते। द्रोणे च पुरुषव्याने स्थिते युद्धाभिनन्दिनि॥
en: How much less reasons have I for fear when I have you as the commander of my armies and that foremost among men, Drona, who takes delight in war, being on my side.

sa: जानामि त्वां युधां श्रेष्ठमत्यन्तं पूर्ववैरिणम्। अनयस्याद्य सम्प्राप्तं फलं पश्य सुदारुणम्॥
en: “I know you to be one of the foremost in battle; your enmity for us in days gone by, was also implacable. Today, reap the mortal fruit of that wicked behaviour of yours.

sa: घटोत्कचस्य राजेन्द्र ध्वजे गृध्रो व्यरोचत। अश्वाश्च कामगास्तस्य रावणस्य पुरा यथा॥
en: O monarch, the device of a vulture enhanced the beauty of the standard of Ghatotkacha; his steeds had the power of ranging everywhere at will, like those of Ravana in days of yore.

sa: अश्वांश्चास्यावधीद् राजन्नुभौ तौ पार्णिसारथी। सोऽवप्लुत्य रथात् तूर्णं गदां जग्राह सात्वतः॥
en: Kripa also slew Chekitana's steeds and the charioteers of those who were protecting him in the flank. Then he of the Satvata race quickly jumping down from his car grasped a arrow mace.

sa: अथ जग्राह गोविन्दो रश्मीन् रश्मिविदां वरः। मातलिसिवस्येव वृत्रं हन्तुं प्रयास्यतः॥
en: The Govinda that best of charioteers took up the reins (of Arjuna's steeds)., like Matali taking up the reins of Indra's horses, when the latter went to fight in order to slay Vritra.

sa: कुरुभिः सहितं भीष्मं युध्यमानं परंतप। अर्जुनं च समाञ्चाल्यं संशयो विजयेऽभवत्॥
en: Beholding Bhishma fighting at the head of the Kurus and Arjuna at the head of Panchala troops, we were unable, O afflicter of foes, to divine as to which side would be victorious.

sa: तमजेयं राक्षसेन्द्रं संख्ये मघवता अपि। शैनेयः प्राणदज्जित्वा योधानां तव पश्यताम्॥
en: Then having vanquished that foremost of the Rakshasas who could not be vanquished even by Indra himself the grandson of Shini uttered a loud roar, even before the very eyes of your warriors.

sa: धूम्रारुणं रजस्तीव्र रणभूमि समावृणोत्। नैव स्वेन परे राजन् समजानन् परस्परम्॥
en: Then the field of battle, O king, was shrouded by a thick cloud of dust of the reddish hue of smoke; and none was able to distinguish between his friend and his foe.

sa: अधियज्ञः कथं कोऽत्र देहेऽस्मिन् मधुसूदन। प्रयाणकाले च कथं ज्ञेयोऽसि नियतात्मभिः॥
en: And Adhiyajna, and how (they are in this body), O destroyer of Madhu? And how, too, are you to be known by those who restrain their selves, at the time of their death”.

sa: उपास्यमानो बहुभिः कुरुपाण्डवसात्वतैः। सूत तस्य गृहे शब्दो नाद्य द्रौणेर्यथा पुरा॥
en: Who was worshipped by many persons among the Kurus, the Pandavas and the Satvatas-you son of Suta, even in the carp of that son of Drona no sound could be heard as before.

sa: दी? द्वादश गव्यूतिः पश्चाः पञ्च विस्तृतः। व्यूहस्तु चक्रशकटो भारद्वाजेन निर्मितः॥
en: The array that the son of Bharadvaja then formed, partly figuring a sakata and partly a circle, was full forty-eight miles in length and its back portion, in width, measured full twenty miles.

sa: न भीष्मव्यसनं कश्चिद् दृष्ट्वा कर्णममन्यत॥ विशोकाश्चाभवन् सर्वे राजानः कुरुभिः सह।
en: All the kings and the Kurus, seeing Karna, did pay no heed to the calamity that had befallen them in the shape of Bhishma's death and they all were shorn of their sorrow.

sa: सैन्यानि रौद्राणि भयानकानि व्यूढानि सम्यग् बहुलध्वजानि। स्ते पाण्डवानां त्वरिता महारथाः॥
en: "Our troops are fierce and formidable and duly arranged; and they carry mighty standards, and yet those heroic and fleet host of car-warrior belonging to the Pandava army, penetrating and slaughtering and crushing.

sa: यथा दीपो निवातस्थो नेङ्गते सोपमा स्मृता। योगिनो यतचित्तस्य युञ्जतो योगमात्मनः॥
en: A light, in a place where there is no air, flickers not; this has been cited as a simile to a yogi whose mind has been restrained, and who devotes himself to abstraction.

sa: शरैरवर्षन् द्रुपदस्य पुत्रं यथाम्बुदा भूधरं वारिजालैः। न विव्यथे समरे चित्रयोधी॥
en: Showered arrows on the son of Drupada, like the clouds showering rain on mountain breasts. But the latter, accomplished in various modes of warfare, though thus wounded with keen-pointed shafts did not flinch.

sa: हातेजोबलाः सर्वे तदा सेन्द्रा दिवौकसः। ब्रह्माणं शरणं जग्मुर्वत्राद् भीता महासुरात्॥
en: All those dwellers of heaven then with Indra at their head, destitute of their head, destitute of their energy and prowess, sought refuge with Brahman being highly afraid of the mighty Asura Vritra.

sa: न तु पर्यायधर्मेण राज्यं प्राप्नोति मानुषः। मनसैवानुकूलानि विधाता कुरुते वशे॥
en: Man does not obtain success in his desires simple as a matter of course, By mere will force does the Creator make unfavourable circumstances turn into favourable ones and get them under control.

sa: यत्तस्य घटमानस्य क्षिप्रं विक्षिपतः शरान्। लाघवात् पाण्डुपुत्रस्य व्यस्मयन्त परे जनाः॥
en: The troops belonging to the party hostile to him, were then amazed by beholding the lightness of hands with which he took out his shafts, placed them on the bow-string and discharged them.

sa: अस्त्रं चतुर्विधं वीरे यस्मिन्नासीत् प्रतिष्ठितम्। तमिष्वस्त्रधराचार्ये द्रोणं शंससि मे हतम्॥
en: In that mighty warrior, the knowledge of all the four kinds of wcapons was present. Do you say to me that Drona, that preceptor of all wielders of arrows and weapons is slain?

sa: रथे बातजवा युक्ताः सर्वशास्त्रातिगा रणे। बलिनो हैषिणो दान्ताः सैन्धवाः साधुवाहिनः॥
en: Fleet as the wind, yoked to his car, beyond the reach of all weapons in battle, endued with great strength, emitting neights (in joy), welltrained, of the Sindhu breed, excellently dragging the chariot.

sa: शरार्ता न जहुर्दोणं पञ्चालाः पाण्डवैः सह। ततो द्रोणोऽतिसंक्रुद्धो विसृजञ्छतश: शरान्॥
en: Thereat Drona, excited to the highest pitch of fury, spread a great carnage among the ranks of the Chedis, the Panchalas and the Pandavas, by means of arrows which he discharged by hundreds.

sa: एतद् बुद्ध्या विनिश्चित्य मनसा भरतर्षभ। यत् क्षमं ते महाबाहो तदिहारब्धुमर्हसि॥
en: Setting, in your mind, something suitable to this turn of affairs, 0 best among the Bharatas, it is proper that you should do what you can for me, O you of long arms.

sa: स मां प्रतिक्षते व्यक्तं शाल्वराजो विशाम्पते। तस्मान्मां त्वं कुरुश्रेष्ठ समनुज्ञातुमर्हसि॥
en: It is evident, O lord of the universe, that the king of the Shalvas is expecting me; it is proper for you therefore to permit me to go, O foremost among the Kurus.

sa: मातरिश्वा ततस्तस्मिन् मेघरुद्ध इवाभवत्। ततो वायोः प्रकम्पाच्च सूर्यस्य च गभस्तिभिः॥
en: The very wind then shut up in that net could not pass through it. Then owing to the wind being shut up, and the sun too not being able to impart its rays,

sa: तेनावध्या रणे पार्था जययुक्ताश्च पार्थिव। तव पुत्रा दुरात्मानः पापेष्वभिरताः सदा॥
en: For this reason, O ruler of earth, the sons of Pritha are unslayable in battle and are ever courted by victory. Your sons are of wicked intentions and are intent on perpetrating sin;

sa: न चैनं पाण्डवेयानां कश्चिच्छक्नोति भारत। वीक्षितुं समरे क्रुद्धं महेन्द्रमिव दानवाः॥
en: O Bharata, as the Danavas were unable to look at the great Indra, so none among ti army of the sons of Pandu, was able to look his wrathful self (Drona) in battle.

sa: वरान् वरान् विनिघ्नन्तं पाण्डुपुत्रस्य सैनिकान्। युगान्तमिव कुर्वाणं भीष्मं यौधिष्ठिरे बले॥
en: And marking also that hero (Bhishma) was killing the foremost warriors of Yudhisthira's army and that he was making a great havoc amongst the troops as if the hour of dissolution had come.

sa: शिखण्डी समरामर्षी शूरश्च समितिञ्जयः। यथाभवञ्च स्त्री पूर्वं पश्चात् पुंस्त्वं ममागतः॥
en: That mighty car-warrior, O king, that son of Draupada, who belongs to your army, who is known under the name of Shikhandin, who is wrathful in battle, valiant and ever attended with victory,

sa: देहिनोऽस्मिन् यथा देहे कौमारं यौवनं जरा। तथा देहान्तरप्राप्तिर्षीरस्तत्र न मुह्यति॥
en: As childhood, youth and old age are (changes) in the body of man, so death is but a change of this body to another. A man of knowledge is not deluded by it.

sa: स बर्हिबर्हावततं किंकिणीशतजालवत्। चर्म चादाय खङ्गं च नदन् पर्यपतद् रथात्॥
en: Grasping a sword and a shield decorated with the emblem of a peacock and furnished with a row of hundred small tinklers and uttering a loud roar, he jumped down from his chariot.

sa: न तु पर्यायधर्मेण सिद्धि प्राप्नोति मानवः। मनसैवानुकूलानि धातैव कुरुते वशे॥
en: Man does not obtain success in his desires simply as a matter of course, By mere will force does the Creator make unfavourable circumstances turn into favourable ones and get them under control.

sa: तस्मिन् दशरथे क्रुद्धे वर्तमाने महाभये। तावकानां परेषां वा प्रेक्षका रथिनोऽभवन॥
en: When those ten warriors, wrought up with wrath, met the other ten in that awful battle, thereat of the car-warriors of your army and of the army of your foes became sight seers.

sa: उच्चुक्रुशुस्ततः सर्वे तावका भरतर्षभ। शक्तिं विनिहतां दृष्ट्वा वैराटिः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः।।८ 1८८॥
en: All your troops, O best of the Bharata race, then sent up a loud shout of joy. Virata's son, however, having seen his dart cut down into fragments, lost all sense in anger.

sa: आगुल्फेभ्योऽवसीदन्ते नरा लोहितकर्दमैः। दीप्यमानैः परिक्षिप्ता दावैरिव महाद्रुमाः॥
en: In that gory mire men sank ankle-deep; and they looked like mighty trees the lower portion of which were enveloped in forest conflagration

sa: पुरस्कृत्य महाराज भीमसेनघटोत्कचौ। पूजयन्तस्तदाऽन्योन्यं मुदा परमया युताः॥
en: And, O mighty monarch, they proceeded placing Bhimasena and Ghatotkacha at their van, and 0 mighty sovereign, worshipping them out of great delight.

sa: तमापतन्तं सम्प्रेक्ष्य राजानं प्रति वेगितम्। अभ्यधावञ्जिघांसन्तस्तावका युद्धदुर्मदाः॥
en: Beholding him make towards the king with impetuosity, your warriors, all invincible in battle, rushed at him, desirous of doing away with him.

sa: अतिविद्धाश्च नाराचैर्वमन्तो रुधिरं मुखैः। मुहूर्तात्र्यपतन्नन्ये वारणा वसुधातले॥
en: Other elephants again pierced deep with Narachas and vomitting blood in consequence, fell down on the ground as soon as they were struck.

sa: सेनापतिवचः श्रुत्वा शिखण्डिप्रमुखा गणाः। भीममेवाभ्यवर्तन्त रथानीकैः प्रहारिभिः॥
en: Having heard the word of their commander, many heroes headed by Shikhandin came to the help of Bhima, supported by many wellskilled car-warriors.

sa: चित्रायुधं चित्रमाल्यं चित्रवर्मायुधध्वजम्। ऊहुः किंशुकपुष्पाणां समवर्णा हयोत्तमाः।
en: Superior steeds of hue resembling that of the Kinshuka flowers, bore Chitrayudha, decorated with beautiful garlands and owning beautiful armour, weapons and standard.

sa: सौमदत्तिस्तु राजानं मणिमन्तमतन्द्रितम्। पर्यवारयदायान्तं यशो द्रोणस्य वर्धयन्॥
en: The son of Somadatta for adding to the glory of Drona, opposed the ever vigilant king Manimanta as the latter rushed towards Drona.

sa: श्रुत्वा तु निहतं राधेयः पुरुषर्षभः। ईषदागतसंत्रासस्त्वरयोपजगाम ह॥
en: Hearing of the slaughter of Bhishma, that best of men, Vikarna's terrified to a certain extent, quickly to the spot where Bhishma lay.

sa: प्रतिदिव्याध राधेयस्तावद्भिरथ तं पुनः। शरैराचितसर्वाङ्गो बह्वशोभत भारत॥
en: Thereupon Radha's son pierced him in return with as many arrows. Covered all over with arrows, O Bharata, he then looked exceedingly beautiful.

sa: सदृशो वृष्णिवीरस्य केशवस्य महात्मनः। विक्रमश्रुतमाहात्म्यैः कथमायोधने हतः॥
en: How has that hero resembling the highsouled Vrishni hero Keshava himself in prowess, generosity and acquaintance with the Shastras, been slain in battle?

sa: सात्यकिः कृतवर्माणं वारयित्वा महारणे। शरैर्बहुविधै राजन्नाससाद पितामहम्॥
en: Approached the grandsire Bhishma, shooting various kinds of arrows. Then he, having pierced the grandsire with sixty whetted shafts furnished with feathery wings,

sa: क्षमावन्तोऽवहन् संख्ये सेनाबिन्दुमरिंदमम्। युवानमवहन् युद्धे क्रोञ्चवर्णा हयोत्तमाः॥
en: Of quiet nature, bore into battle Senavindu, that chastiser of foes. Excellent steeds of the colour of cream, carried into battle the youthful.

sa: कार्यकरणकर्तृत्वे हेतुः प्रकृतिरुच्यते। पुरुषः सुखदुःखानां भोक्तृत्वे हेतुरुच्यते॥
en: Prakriti is the source of the workings of cases and effects. Prakriti is the source of the capacity of enjoying pleasures and pains.

sa: तस्मान्मृत्युमहं मन्ये प्राप्तकालमिवात्मनः॥ एवं ज्ञात्वा व्यवसितं भीष्मस्यामिततेजसः।
en: I now think that the proper time for my death has arrived." Ascertaining this to be the intention of Bhishma of immeasurable energy,

sa: धूमेनाव्रियते वह्निर्यथादर्शो मलेन च। यथोल्बेनावृतो गर्भस्तथा तेनेदमावृतम्॥
en: As fire is enveloped by smoke, a mirror by dust, the foetus by the womb, so this (true knowledge) is enveloped by Desire.

sa: भीमसेनस्तु कौन्तेयो द्रोणं दृष्ट्वा पराक्रमी। अभ्ययाज्जवनैरश्वैर्भारद्वाजस्य वाहिनीम्॥
en: Bhimasena the son of Kunti, endued with great prowess, beholding Drona, rushed against the division of Bharadvaja's son, being borne by fleetest steeds.

sa: अभिमन्युमुखास्तत् तु नामृष्यन्त महारथाः। भीमस्याच्छादनं संख्ये स्वबाहुबलमाश्रिताः॥
en: Then the mighty car-warriors headed by Abhimanyu, who all relied on the strength of their arms, could not brook this interception of Bhima.

sa: सुवर्णवर्णाश्च नराः स्त्रियश्चाप्सरसोपमाः। अनामया वीतशोका नित्यं मुदितमानसाः॥
en: The men are of golden complexion. Women are all like Apsaras. All the persons are without sickness, and grief, and are always cheerful.

sa: सुदक्षिणस्तु समरे पुनर्विव्याध पञ्चभिः। सारथिं चास्य नवभिरिच्छन् भोष्मस्य जीवितम्॥ तद् युद्धमासीत् सुमहत् तयोस्तत्र समागमे।
en: Once more wounded the king with sixty four arrows. Thereupon Sudakshina also, desirous of saving Bhishma's life in battle, pierced Abhimanyu with five shafts and the latter's charioteer with nine arrows. Then the battle that ensued consequent upon the encounter of those two heroes, exceedingly pierce.

sa: यदाभ्यधावद् गाङ्गेयं शिखण्डी शत्रुकर्शनः॥ विराटदुपदौ वृद्धौ वारयन्तौ महाचमूम्। भीष्मं च युधि संरब्धावाद्रवन्तौ महारथौ॥ अश्वत्थामा रणे क्रुद्धः समायाद्रथसत्तमः।
en: Shikhandin that grinder of foes rushed against the son of Ganga. The two old mighty car-warriors, Draupada and Virata, inflamed with rage, rushed to fight with Bhishma, holding at bay the army of the Kauravas as was they advanced. Thereupon that foremost of carwarriors namely Ashvathama, wrought up with wrath confronted both those warriors in battle.

sa: यत्रेदृशं बलं घोरं पाण्डवान्नातरद् रणे॥ पाण्डवाार्थाय नियतं देवास्तत्र समागताः। युध्यन्ते मामकं सैन्यं यथाऽध्यत संजय॥
en: This all appears me reverse to listen that so vast army could not face and defeat Pandavas in battle. O Sanjaya! The gods come in support of Pandavas definitely and battle against my army. This is the reason, it is being slaughtered in uncountable numbers day-to-day.

sa: इत्येवमुक्त्वा राजानं धर्मपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम्। अभ्यावृत्य पुनर्जिष्णुमुलूकः प्रत्यभाषत॥
en: Saying this to the king Yudhishthira the son of Dharma Uluka again turned to the one accustomed to victories and said to him,

sa: अथ भीमरथः शाल्वमाशुगैरायसैः शितैः। षड्भिः साश्वनियन्तारमनयद् यमसादनम्॥
en: Then Bhimaratha, with six swift-going shafts, made wholly of iron, dispatched Shalva together with his steeds and charioteer to the regions of Death.

sa: तावेकरथसंयुक्तौ सौबलेयस्य वाहिनीम्। व्यधमेतां शितैस्तूर्णं शरैः संनतपर्वभिः॥
en: Then those two heroes, mounting on the same car, began to slaughter the army of Subala's son (Shakuni) with innumerable sharp pointed arrows.

sa: प्रक्षीणसायकाः शूरा निहताश्वाः श्रमातुराः। विलयं समनुप्राप्तास्तक्षमाणाः परस्परम्॥
en: Warriors, mutilated with shafts, with their chargers slain, and themselves exhausted with was fatigue, began to perish, cutting one another with their swords.

sa: निद्रहन्तमनीकानि साक्षादग्निमिवोत्थितम्। दृष्ट्वा रुक्मरथं क्रुद्धं समकम्पन्त सृञ्जया:॥
en: The Srinjayas began to tremble with fear, seeing that enraged hero of the golden cam (Drona), consume their division like a raging conflagration.

sa: कौरवं सात्यकिश्चैव शरैः संनतपर्वभिः। अवारयदमेयात्मा सर्वलोकस्य पश्यतः॥
en: Thereat, before the very eyes of the spectators, Satyaki of immeasurable soul shrouded with his arrows of straight-joints, him of the Kaurava host.

sa: धनुः प्रपीड्य वामन करेणामित्रकर्शनः। गाण्डीवधन्वा संक्रुद्धः शितान् संनतपर्वणः॥ जीवितान्तकरान् घोरान् समादत्त शिलीमुखान्। तैस्तूर्णं समरेऽविध्यद् द्रौणि बलवतां वरः॥
en: And also that grinder of foes that foremost of mighty heroes pressing his bow with his left arm, and excited with rage, and wielding the Gandiva bow, placed on the bow-string sharp and straight and fierce shafts capable of depriving a foe of his life; and therewith, in that battle, speedily pierced the son of Drona.

sa: संजय उवाच विराटोऽथ त्रिभिर्बाणैर्भीष्ममार्छन्महारथम्। विव्याध तुरगांश्चास्य त्रिभिर्बाणैर्महारथः॥
en: Sanjaya said Then the mighty car-warrior Virata pierced with three arrows the mighty car-warrior Bhishma, and the latter's steeds with another three arrows.

sa: न्यकृन्तन्नुमाङ्गानि शरेण हयसादिनाम्। ते निपेतुर्महाराज निहता दृढधन्विभिः॥
en: Began to sever the heads of these horsesoldiers from their trunk; then, O mighty monarch, they fell down slain by these firm bowmen,

sa: मण्डलीभूतवास्य नित्यं धनुरदृश्यत। संग्रामे युद्ध्यमानस्य शक्रचापोपमं महत्॥
en: As Bhishma fought on, his bow that resembled the mighty bow of Indra (Rainbow) was seen to remain continuously in a circular form.

sa: सुतसोमस्तु संक्रुद्धः स्वपितृव्यमजिह्मगैः। विविंशति शर्भित्त्वा नाभ्यवर्तत दंशितः॥
en: Sutasoma also excited with anger and clad in mail pierced his uncle Vivinsati with straight-going shafts and he desisted from attacking the latter.

sa: सात्यकिश्चाभिमन्युश्च धृष्टद्युम्नवृकोदरौ। पर्यरक्षन्त राजानं यमौ च मनुजेश्वरम्॥
en: Satyaki, Abhimanyu, Dhrishtadyumna and Vrikodara, and the twins Nakula and Sahadeva are all engaged in protecting that foremost of men viz., king Yudhishthira.

sa: युञ्जन्नेव सदाऽऽत्मानं योगी विगतकल्मषः। सुखेन ब्रह्मसंस्पर्शमत्यन्तं सुखमश्नुते॥
en: Thus constantly devoting his self to abstraction, a yogi, being freed from sin, casily achieves the supreme happiness, namely the contact with Brahma.

sa: सहदेवस्तु शकुनिमुलूकं च महारथम्। पितापुत्रौ महेष्वासावभ्यवर्तत दुर्जयौ॥
en: Sahadeva rushed against the two mighty car-warriors, both skillful bowmen and invincible in battle, namely, Shakuni and Uluka who were father and son.

sa: गर्भिण्योऽजातपुत्राश्च जनयन्ति विभीषणान्। क्रव्यादाः पक्षिभिश्चापि सहाश्नन्ति परस्परम्॥
en: Women who are pregnant and those that are not, are giving birth to monsters, Carnivorous beasts mingle with birds and are feeding together.

sa: चक्ररक्षौ ततस्तस्य भीमसेनधनंजयौ। पृष्ठतो द्रौपदेयाश्च सौभद्रश्चैव वीर्यवान्॥
en: Then Bhimasena and Dhananjaya became the protectors of his car-wheels. Behind him were the sons of Draupadi and the highly puissant of Subhadra.

sa: सम्पूर्णं योधमुख्यैश्च तथा दन्तिपदातिभिः। रथैरनेकसाहौः समन्तात् परिवारितम्॥
en: The array teemed with excellent warriors, as also with tuskers and infantry and it was surrounded on all sides with many thousand cars.

sa: तेषां विदुरवाक्यानां मुक्तानां दीर्घदर्शनात्॥ दृष्ट्वेमां फलनिर्वृत्तिं मन्ये शोचन्ति पुत्रकाः। सेनां दृष्ट्वाभिभूतां मे शैनेयेनार्जुनेन च॥
en: I think my foolish sons are now overwhelmed with grief, seeing now the words of the far-sighted Vidura to be true and fruitful. I think my foolish sons are now indulging in lamentations seeing the army sorely distressed by Arjuna and the grand son of Sini.

sa: तर्जयन्तमनीकानि तानि तानि महारथम्। सर्वतोऽभ्यद्रवन द्रोणं युधिष्ठिरपुरोगमाः॥
en: Then all those divisions having Yudhishthira at their head, assaulted on all sides that mighty car-warrior Drona who had been uttering loud shouts.

sa: तदाश्चर्यमपश्याम पाण्डवस्य महात्मनः। भीमसेनस्य समरे राजन् कर्मातिमानुषम्॥
en: The, O monarch, we beheld in that battle, the marvelous and super human feat achieved by the high-souled son of Pandu, namely Bhimasena.

sa: अथार्जुनोऽब्रवीत् पार्थं युधिष्ठिरममित्रहा। विषण्णमिव सम्प्रेक्ष्य तव राजन्ननीकिनीम्॥
en: O king, that chastiser of foes, Arjuna, thus spoke of your army to the son of Pritha, Yudhishthira, who was in great grief.

sa: तत्र तत्रापविद्धैश्च बाहुभिश्चन्दनोक्षितैः। ऊरुभिश्च नरेन्द्राणां समास्तीर्यत मेदिनी॥
en: The battle-field was layered fully with the cut-off and fell everywhere the sandal smeared arms and the legs of the kings slaughtered there.

sa: पदातयश्च ये शूराः कार्मुकासिगदाधराः। सहस्रशोऽन्वयुः पञ्चादग्रतश्च सहस्रशः॥
en: Those warriors who composed the infantry, armed with bows, swords, and maces, followed by thousands in the vanguard, and thousands in the rear.

sa: ततः सरथनागाश्वा भीष्मद्रोणपुरोगमाः। अभ्यवर्तन्त राजानः सहिताः सव्यसाचिनम्॥
en: Thereupon the kings headed by Bhishma and Drona and accompanied by many elephants, horses and cars rushed with great force on Savyasachin (Arjuna).

sa: आत्तशस्त्रो रणे यत्तो गृहीतवरकार्मुकः। मां पातयतु बीभत्सुरेवं तव जयो ध्रुवम्॥ एतत् कुरुष्व कौन्तेय यथोक्तं मम सुव्रत। संग्रामे धार्तराष्ट्रांश्च हन्याः सर्वान् समागतान्॥
en: Therefore let Vibhatsu armed with weapons and excreting in battle to the best of his abilities and wielding his excellent bow, overthrow me in battle, placing (this Shikhandin or) any one else before him. Thus victory will be yours with certainty. O foremost of kings, O you of chaste vows, do as I tell you. Then you shall be able to slay in battle all the Dhritarashtra assembled together.

sa: तोमराभिहताः केचिद् बाणैश्च परमद्विपाः। वित्रेसुः सर्वनागानां शब्दमेवापरेऽव्रजन्॥
en: Some of those huge elephants being struck with arrows and some with lances, were inspired with panic and others began to roar aloud.

sa: भगवन् क्रोधसंदीप्तः क्रोधादग्निमवासृजत्। स दहत्यश्मकूटानि गुमांश्च सरितस्तथा॥
en: You have, O lord, blazed up in anger from anger this fire has proceeded and that fire now consumes rocks, trees and rivers.

sa: तं तथा पतितं शूरं तावकाः पर्यवारयन्। दावं दग्ध्वा यथा शान्तं पावकं शिशिरात्यये॥ विमृद्य नागशृङ्गाणि संनिवृत्तमिवानिलम्। अस्तंगतमिवादित्यं तप्त्वा भारतवाहिनीम्॥ उपप्लुतं यथा सोमं संशुष्कमिव सागरम्। पूर्णचन्द्राभवदनं काकपक्षवृताक्षिकम्॥ तं भूमौ पतितं दृष्टवा तावकास्ते महारथाः। मुदा परमया युक्ताश्चक्रुशुः सिंहवन्मुहुः॥
en: Then your troops surrounded the fallen hero, who then looked like an extinguished fire that had consumed a whole forest during the summer season; or like a tempest with its fury subsided after it has broken down numerous tree-tops; or like the setting sun that had scorched the Bharata army with its rays; or like the moon devoured up by the Rahu; or like the ocean with its waters dried up. Then the mighty car-warriors of your army beholding Abhimanyu whose countenance wore the splendour of the full moon and whose eyes were black like the wings of the raven, lie prostrate on the naked earth, uttered repeated lion-like roars being filled with great delight.

sa: द्रोणपुत्रं शिनेर्नप्ता धृष्टकेतुस्तु पौरवम्। अभिमन्युः सहामात्यं दुर्योधनमयोधयत्॥
en: The grandson of Shini fought with Drona's son, Dhrishtaketu with the descendant of Puru and Yudhamanyu with king. Duryodhana and his ministers. son

sa: विद्याविशेषमिच्छामि ज्ञातुमाचार्य तत्त्वतः। अर्जुनस्यात्मनश्चैव याथातथ्यं प्रचक्ष्व मे॥
en: O preceptor, I want to know exactly the difference, as regards proficiency in arms between myself and Arjuna. Say it to me truly."

sa: विमुखीकृत्य कर्णे तु सौभद्रः कङ्कपत्रिभिः। अन्यानपि महेष्वासांस्तूर्णमेवाभिदुद्ववे॥
en: Thereafter having compelled Karna 10 tumn back from the field with arrows furnished with Kanka feathers, Subhadra's son quickly assailed other mighty bowmen.

sa: सनागाश्वमनुष्याणां ये च शिल्पोपजीविनः। ये चान्येऽनुगतास्तत्र सूतमागधबन्दिनः॥
en: And elephants, horses and other men. Those who lived by mechanical arts and those who followed them there as bards, singers and panegyrists.

sa: चर्माथादत्त गाड्यो जातरूपपरिष्कृतम्॥ खङ्गं चान्यतप्रेप्सुर्मृत्योरगे जयाय वा।
en: Thereafter Ganga's son grasped a buckler of the polish of gold, as also a resplendent sword, desirous of reaping either victory or death.

sa: एवमाश्वास्य भगिनीं द्रौपदीमपि चोत्तराम्। पार्थस्यैव महाबाहुः पार्श्वमागादरिंदमः॥
en: Thus having consoled his sister and Draupadi and Uttara, that subduer of foes, that mighty-armed one, (viz., Krishna) came back to Partha's side.

sa: स प्रगृह्य महाघोरं निस्त्रिशवरमायसम्। पदातिस्तूर्णमानछेद् रथस्थं पुरुषर्षभः॥
en: Then taking up a fearful sword made of steel, he walked on foot and came to Drupada's son who was on the car.

sa: जैत्रैः सांग्रामिकैर्मन्त्रैः पूर्वमेव रथोत्तमम्। अभिमन्त्रितमर्चिष्मानुदयं भास्करो यथा॥
en: That excellent vehicle of his which had been previously purified with victory-giving mantras, like the sun of burning radiance ascending the Eastern mountains.

sa: भीष्ममेवाभ्यलीयन्त सह सर्वैस्तवात्मजैः। तेषामार्तायनमभूद् भीष्मः शान्तनवो रणे॥
en: Threw themselves upon the protection of Bhishma, along of with your sons. In that battle Bhishma the son of Shantanu became their refuge.

sa: वत्सदन्तैश्च भल्लैश्च तमेकमभिदुद्रुवुः॥ सिंहनादस्ततो घोरः पाण्डवानामभूत् तदा।
en: With Vatsadantas, and broad-headed arrows, rushed against that single warrior. Then loud was the sin of war-cries that rang through the Pandava ranks.

sa: येन नागेन मघवानजयद् दैत्यदानवान्। तदन्वयेन नागेन भीमसेनमुपाद्रवत्॥
en: Bhagadatta attacked on Bhimasena by riding on the elephant of Airavata breed using which as vehicle, Indra had defeated the demons and monsters.

sa: ते निकृत्तमहाचापास्त्वरमाणा महारथाः। रथशक्ती: परामृश्य विनेदुभैरवान् रवान्॥
en: Those heroes, those great car-warriors whose large bows had been cut down swelled in wrath, and grasping darts, sent forth a loud shout.

sa: इन्द्रायुधसवर्णैस्तु कुन्तिभोजो हयोत्तमैः। आयात् सदश्वैः पुरुजिन्मातुलः सव्यसाचिनः॥
en: Borne by excellent steeds of the best breed and of the colour of rainbow, came Kuntibhoja or Purujit the maternal uncle of Savyasachin.

sa: दुर्योधनं पीड्यमानं दृष्ट्वा भीमेन मारिष। चक्षोभयिषुरभ्यागादङ्गो मातङ्गमास्थितः॥
en: Beholding Duryodhana afflicted by Bhima, O sire, the sovereign of the Angas, riding on an elephant, came with a view to afflict Bhima,

sa: तं द्रोणः पञ्चविंशत्या मर्मभिद्भिरजिह्मगैः। अन्तेवासिनमाचार्यो महेष्वासं समार्पयत्॥
en: The preceptor Drona then pierced his disciple, that great bowman Arjuna, with twenty-five straight-flying that penetrated to the very vitals of the latter.

sa: देवानतर्पयद् यज्ञैः श्राद्धस्तद्वत् पितृनपि। दीनाननुग्रहैरिष्टैः कामैश्च द्विजसत्तमान्॥
en: He pleased the celestials, by performing sacrifices, the Pitris by Shraddhas, the poor by charities and the good Brahmana by fulfilling their desires.

sa: सर्वभूतशरण्याय रामायाकिष्टकर्मणे। भयेष्वभयदात्रे च तस्मै वक्तुं समुत्सहे॥
en: "I wish to relate it to Räma of unwearied actions, who is the refuge of all creatures and who declares fearlessness to all.

sa: वङ्गपुण्ड्रकिरातेषु राजा बलसमन्वितः। पौण्ड्रको वासुदेवेति योऽसौ लोकेऽभिविश्रुतः॥
en: The powerful king of Vanga, Pundra and the Kiratas who is known by the name of Pundraka and Vasudeva, (also waits upon Jarasandha).

sa: यथा पाण्डुर्महाबाहुर्धनुर्धरवरो युधि। वभूब मृगयाशील: पुराऽस्य प्रपितामहः॥
en: He was like his great grandfather, Pandu, mighty in arms, the best of all bow-men in battle and was very fond of hunting.

sa: त्वाष्ट्री तु सवितुर्भार्या वडवारूपधारिणी। असूयत महाभागा सान्तरिक्षेऽश्विनावुभौ॥
en: Tvashtri, who had the form of a mare, became the wife of Savita. She gave birth in the sky to a twin Ashvinis.

sa: प्रभिन्नकरटौ मत्तौ भूत्वा कुञ्जररूपिणौ। संलीनमपि दुर्गेषु निन्यतुर्यमसादनम्॥
en: They assumed the forms of maddened elephants with temples rent (from excess of juice) and they slaughtered the Rishis hidden in mountain caves.

sa: अतिनिर्मथनादेव कालकूटस्ततः परः। जगदावृत्य सहसा सधूमोऽग्निरिव ज्वलन्॥
en: Because of the great churning, then appeared deadly poison, which soon covered the whole earth and blazed up like a fire with fumes.

sa: पुष्पवत्सु ध्रुवा श्रीश्च पुष्पवन्तस्ततो वयम्। क्षत्रियो बाहुवीर्यस्तु न तथा वाक्यवीर्यवान्। अप्रगल्भं वचस्तस्य तस्माद् बार्हद्रथेरितम्॥
en: Persons who adorn themselves with flowers always gain prosperity, therefore we have adorned ourselves with flowers. The Kshatriyas are powerful in their prowess of arms and in the prowess of speech. O son of Brihadratha it is therefore the speeches of the Kshatriyas are never audacious.

sa: कलेरंशस्तु संजज्ञे भुवि दुर्योधनो नृपः। दुर्बुद्धिर्दुर्मतिश्चैव कुरूणामयशस्करः॥
en: The evil and wicked-minded king Duryodhana, the destroyer of the fame of the Kuru dynasty, was born of the portion of the Kali.

sa: सौतिरुवाच एवं स्तुतस्तदा कव्वा भगवान्हरिवाहनः। नीलजीमूतसंघातैः सर्वमम्बरमावृणोत्॥
en: Sauti said: Having been thus adored by Kadru, the God, having the best horses to ride, covered all the sky with blue clouds.

sa: ते सर्वे हृष्टमनसः परस्परसमागमे। हितैषिणो बाल्हिपतेः पृथग्वाक्यान्यथाब्रुवन्॥
en: Being greatly delighted for their arrival they all gave out their individual opinion for bringing about the well-being of the king of Valhika.

sa: महाकायो महावेगो दारयन्निव मेदिनीम्। लोहिताक्षः करालश्च लोहितश्मश्रुमूर्धजः॥
en: Of huge body, of great strength, of fierce appearance, with red eyes, red beard, red hair, he pressed the earth (as he walked).

sa: असुरास्तत्र मां दृष्ट्वा कस्त्वमित्यभ्यचोदयन्। बृहस्पतिसुतश्चाहं कच इत्यभिविश्रुतः॥
en: The Asuras, having seen me there, asked me, “Who are you?” They heard my this reply, "I am Kacha, the son of Brihaspati."

sa: ब्रह्मरूपधराज्छ्रुत्वा प्रशान्तान् पाण्डुनन्दनान्। कौन्तेयान् मनुजेन्द्राणां विस्मयः समजायत॥
en: The monarchs were very much astonished to learn that the sons of Kunti, the Pandavas, had assumed the guise of the peaceful Brahmanas.

sa: मत्तवहिणसंघुष्टकोकिलैश्च सदामदैः। गृहैरादर्शविमलैर्विविधैश्च लतागृहैः॥ मनोहरैचित्रगृहैस्तथाजगतिपर्वतैः। वापीभिर्विविधाभिश्च पूर्णाभिः परमाम्भसा॥ सरोभिरतिरम्यैश्च पद्मोत्पलसुगन्धिभिः। हंसकारण्डवयुतैश्चक्रवाकोपशोभितैः॥ रम्याश्च विविधास्तत्र पुष्करिण्यो वनावृताः। तडागानि च रम्याणि बृहन्ति सुबहूनि च॥
en: These verdant groves were resounded with the notes of the maddened peacocks and Kokilas. There were various pleasure houses bright as mirrors and innumerable bowers of creepers, charming artificial hillocks, many lakes full to the brim with crystal water and delightful tanks fragrant with lotuses and lilies and adorned with swans, ducks and Chakravakas. There many tanks overgrown with fine aquatic plants and various large and beautiful pounds. were

sa: ततः सूक्ष्माम्बरधरो ब्रह्ममावर्तयन्परम्। कुशान्गृहीत्वा पाणिभ्यां सरयूं प्रययावथ॥
en: There upon wearing a thin cloth, holding Kuśa grass by his fingers, and reciting Vedic hymns he proceeded to the banks of Sarayū.

sa: दर्शनीयानवद्याङ्गी सुकुमारी मनस्विनी। धृष्टद्युम्नस्य भगिनी द्रोणशत्रोः प्रतापिनः॥
en: With features faultless and with beauty, youth and intelligence; she is the sister of the powerful Dhrishtadyuman, the (would be) slayer of Drona,

sa: स तथा सत्कृतः सर्वैर्भोजवृष्ण्यन्धकात्मजैः। अभिवाद्याभिवाद्यांश्च सर्वेश्च प्रतिनन्दितः॥
en: He was respectfully welcomed by all the Bhojas, the Vrishnis and the Andhakas. He in return worship and received their blessings in return.

sa: दृष्ट्वा निर्वेदमापन्नो व्यासवाक्यप्रचोदितः। धर्मराजं समासाद्य संन्यासं समरोचयत्॥
en: And seeing all this, he went to Yudhishthira by the advice of Vyasa and asked permission to adopt the life of an ascetic.

sa: ऋषयश्च महात्मानः स्वयंवरदिदृक्षवः। दुर्योधनपुरोगाश्च सकर्णाः कुरवो नृप।॥
en: There came also many illustrious Rishis desirous of seeing the Svaimvara. O king, Duryodhana and the Kurus, accompanied by Karna, also came there.

sa: महाबला महोत्साहास्तेन ते बहुधा क्षताः। रेजुरभ्रधनप्रख्या रुधिरौघप्रवर्षिणः॥
en: Those greatly powerful and energetic celestials, mangled all over by that great bird, looked like masses of black clouds, dropping showers of blood.

sa: अजानतः शयानस्य क्रोधेन कलुषीकृतः। उक्तवान्मम शापाग्निं यमदण्डमिवापरम्॥
en: I was unconscious in sleep-— still soiled with anger you have hurled the fiery curse against me like the second rod of Yama.

sa: अश्वत्थामा रहस्येषु सर्वेष्वभ्यधिकोऽभवत्। तथाति पुरुषानन्यान् त्सारुको यमजावुभौ॥
en: Ashvathama excelled all in the mysteries (of the science of arms). The twins (Nakula and Sahadeva) excelled every body in handling the sword.

sa: असुरैः सुरायां भवतोऽस्मि दत्तो हत्वा दग्ध्वा चूर्णयित्वा च काव्य। ब्राह्मीं मायां चासुरीं विप्र मायां त्वयि स्थिते कथमेवातिवर्तेत्॥
en: O son of Kavi, I was killed by the Asuras; my body was burnt and reduced to ashes and I was then given to you with your wine. O Brahman, when you are present, how is possible for the Asura Maya (the power of the Asuras) to overcome the Brahma Maya (the power of the Brahmanas)?

sa: तेन त्यक्तानसंत्याज्यानृषीनण्डगतान् वने॥ न जहौ पुत्रशोकार्ता जरिता खाण्डवे सुतान्। बभार चैतान् संजातान् स्ववृत्त्या स्नेहविपल्वा॥
en: Though forsaken by their father in that forest.of Khandava, Jarita, out of her affection for her children, could not forsake her of offspring, those infant Rishis still living within the eggs. She brought up those children, her self following the pursuit proper to her own species.

sa: दृष्ट्वा च विधिवत् तानि धनं चापि ददौ ततः। कलिङ्गराष्ट्रद्वारेषु ब्राह्मणाः पाण्डवानुगाः। अभ्यनुज्ञाय कौन्तेयमुपावर्तन्त भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, seeing them all and performing many ceremonies and giving away much wealth, he went to the gate of the kingdom of Kalinga where the Brahmanas, who were following him, bade the son of Kunti farewell and desisted from following him any further.

sa: तस्याहं तपसो वीर्यं जानन्नासं तपोधन। भृशमुद्विग्नहृदयस्तमवोचमहं तदा॥
en: O Rishi, I was well aware of the power of penances that he possessed. Therefore, with an agitated heart, I addressed him thus,

sa: तापयामास ताँल्लोकान् सदेवासुरमानुषान्। तपसोग्रेण महता नन्दयिष्यन् पितामहान्॥
en: He afflicted the worlds with the celestials, the Asuras and the men by his greatly serve penances; and he thus gratified his ancestors.

sa: अथवाप्यहमेवैनं हनिष्यामि वृकोदर। कृतकर्मा परिश्रान्तः साधु तावदुपारम॥
en: O Vrikodara, let me kill him alone. You are tired and you have almost finished the work and you well deserve rest (now).

sa: सर्वान्सपिण्डितान्वापि लोकान्सस्थाणुजङ्गमान्। वहेयमपरिश्रान्तो विद्धीदं मे महद् बलम्॥
en: Know, my strength is such that I can bear, without fatigue, even all the worlds put together, with their mobile and immobile objects.

sa: ततोऽभवन् सुरगणाः सहसावाङ्मुखास्तदा। महाभिषस्तु राजर्षिरशङ्को दृष्टवान् नदीम्॥
en: As her person thus became exposed, the celestials bent down their heads, but the royal sage Mahabhisha rudely continued to stare at her.

sa: अधस्तात्तस्य छायायां सुखासीनो नराधिपः। मधुगन्धैश्च संयुक्तं पुष्पगन्धमनोहरम॥
en: The king comfortably seated himself under its cool shade and enjoyed the sweet fragrance of the flowers mixed with the fragrance of honey.

sa: सपर्वतवनामुर्वी ससागरजलामिमाम्। वहे पक्षेण वै शक्र त्वामप्यत्रावलम्बिनम्॥
en: O Indra, I can bear, on a single feather of mine, this earth with her mountains forests, oceans and even you with it.

sa: तस्य रूपगुणोपेता गङ्गा स्त्रीरूपधारिणी। उत्तीर्य सलिलात् तस्माल्लोभनीयतमाकृतिः॥ अधीयानस्य राजर्षेर्दिव्यरूपा मनस्विनी। दक्षिणं शालसंकाशमूरूं भेजे शुभानना॥
en: The accomplished and beautiful Ganga, in the form of a tempting woman, rose from the water and came to the king. That beautifulfeatured lady, that intelligent celestial maiden, endued with ravishing beauty, sat upon the right thigh of the king which was like a Shala tree.

sa: ययातिरुवाच मन्वेति तद् वै पुरुषेण सृष्टम्। स वै तस्या रज आपद्यते वै स गर्भभूतः समुपैति तत्र॥ वनस्पतीनोषधीश्चाविशन्ति अपो वायुं पृथिवीं चान्तरिक्षम्। मेवम्भूता गर्भभूता भवन्ति॥
en: Yayati said : All beings, thus fallen from heaven, become subtle substance, living in water. This water subsequently becomes the semen from which life is created. It then enters the womb of a woman in her season and develops into the embryo. It then becomes visible life like the fruit from the flower. Entering into trees, plants, vegetables, water, air, earth and space, the watery seed of life becomes quadrupeds of bipeds. This is the case with all creatures.

sa: वृष्ण्यन्धकमहामात्रैः सह वीरैर्महारथैः॥ भ्रातृभिश्च कुमारैश्च योधैश्च बहुभिर्वृतः।
en: And the other heroes and great carwarriors of the Vrishni and the Andhaka races and his brothers and sons and many other warriors.

sa: एवं कृतमति: सूर्यो ह्यस्तमभ्यगमद्गिरिम्। तस्माल्लोकविनाशाय संतापयत भास्करः॥
en: With this resolution Surya went to the western mountains and from that place began to scatter his scorching rays to destroy the worlds.

sa: एतदाख्याय काकुत्स्थो भ्रातृभ्याममितप्रभः। लक्ष्मणं पुनरेवाह धर्मयुक्तमिदं वचः॥
en: Having thus addressed his both brothers, Rāma, the descendant of Kākutstha of unmitigated prowess, again said to Laksmana, in words pregnant with morality.

sa: द्रोण उवाच महर्षेरग्निवेशस्य सकाशमहमच्युत। अस्त्रार्थमगमं पूर्वं धनुर्वेदजिघृक्षया॥
en: Drona said: Being desirous of learning the science of arms, I formerly went to the great Rishi Agnivesha for obtaining weapons from him.

sa: पृष्ठ्यनामपि चाश्वानां बालिकानां जनार्दनः। ददौ शतसहस्राख्यं कन्याधनमुत्तमम्॥
en: Janardana (Krishna) also gave them as an excellent dowry of the bride, hundreds of thousands of horses, brought from the country of Balhikas.

sa: एवमुक्तास्तदा भीमो जरासंधमरिंदमः। उत्क्षिप्य भ्रामयामास बलवन्तं महाबलः॥
en: Having been thus addressed, that chastiser of foes, that greatly strong (hero), Bhima, raised up the strong Jarasandha and whirled him on high.

sa: दिव्यचन्दनसंयुक्तं दिव्यधूपेन धूपितम्। तत् सदो वृषभाङ्कस्य दिव्यवादिननादितम्॥
en: It was perfumed with celestial sandal and celestial incense was burnt on all sides. And it echoe with the sounds of celestial instruments.

sa: गोब्राह्मणार्थे विक्रान्तः संग्रामे निधनं गतः॥ अश्वमेधजितॉल्लोकानाप्नोति त्रिदिवालये॥
en: Such a king acquires in the celestial region। such regions of happiness as are capable of being acquired by the performance of Horsesacrifices.

sa: अधर्मस्य क्षयं कृत्वा मृगो वध्यति शस्त्रेण गते संवत्सरे तु सः। हतो मृगस्ततो मीनः सोऽपि जालेन बध्यते॥ मासे चतुर्थे सम्प्राप्ते श्वापदः सम्प्रजायते। श्वापदो दश वर्षाणि द्वीपी वर्षाणि पञ्च च॥
en: Upon the expiration of a year from the time of his birth as a deer, he is killed by a weapon. Thus renouncing his form of a deer, he next takes birth as a fish and dies on account of being dragged up in a net, on the expiration of the fourth month. He has next to take birth as a beasts of prey. He has to live in that form, for ten years and then he takes birth as a bird in which form he has to live for five years.

sa: तां दिदृक्षुरहं योगाच्चतुर्मूर्तित्वमागतः। चतुर्मुखश्च संवृत्तो दर्शयन् योगमुत्तमम्॥
en: Thus, on account of the desire of seeing her, I became fourfaced, through Yogapower. Thus I showed my high Yogapower in becoming fourfaced.

sa: सकृदुत्सृज्य तन्नादं त्रासयानो मृगद्विजान्। मानुषं वचनं प्राह धृष्टो विलशयो महान्॥ सक्तुप्रस्थेन वो नायं यज्ञस्तुल्यो नराधिपाः। उच्छवृत्तेर्वदान्यस्य कुरुक्षेत्रनिवासिनः॥
en: Repeatedly uttering such deep sounds and thereby frightening all animals and birds, that proud dweller of a hole, with large body, spoke in a human voice and said, “You kings, this great sacrifice is not equal to a prastha of powdered daily given away by a liberal Brahmana of Kurukshetra who was observing the Unchcha vow.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। शक्रशम्बरसंवाद तन्निबोध युधिष्ठिर।।।।
en: Bhishma said Regarding it is cited the old history of the discourse between Shakra and Shambara. Do you listen to it, О Yudhishthira.

sa: तौ समेत्य महात्मानौ सुखासीनौ कथाः शुभाः। चक्रतुर्वेदसम्बद्धास्तच्छेषकृतलक्षणाः॥
en: Meeting with each other and seated at their ease, the two began to take on agreeable subjects of the Vedas and the Upanishads.

sa: अस्मिन्नर्थे सत्यवन्तं पर्यपृच्छन्त वै जनाः। कन्यायाः प्राप्तशुल्कायाः शुल्कदः प्रशमं गतः॥४८ पाणिग्रहीता वान्यः स्यादत्र नो धर्मसंशयः। तन्नश्छिन्धि महाप्राज्ञ त्वं हि वै प्राज्ञसम्मतः॥
en: On this subject some people on one occasion had asked prince Satyavat the are following question-If the giver of a dower to the kinsmen of a maiden happens to die before marriage, can another person take the hand of that maiden in marriage? We have doubts on this matter. Do you remove these doubts of ours for you are gifted with great wisdom and are honoured by the wise.

sa: अन्योन्यमथ रज्यन्ते ह्यन्योन्यं चार्थजीविनः। अन्योन्यमाश्रयाः सर्वे तथान्योन्यानुवर्तिनः॥
en: They are attached to one another. They depend on one another. The have one another for their support. They likewise follow one another.

sa: सर्वेषामिति दानानां तिलदानं विशिष्यते। अक्षयं सर्वदानानां तिलदानमिहोच्यते॥
en: The gift of sesame seeds is superior to all gifts. Amongst all gifts, the gift of sesame is considered as yielding unending merit.

sa: अनागतं च न ध्यायेन्नातीतमनुचिन्तयेत्। वर्तमानमुपेक्षेत कालाकाक्षी समाहितः॥
en: One should not think of the past nor feel anxious about the future. One should disregard the present, biding time, with fixed mind.

sa: तिस्रस्तु पाण्डुपुत्राणां चम्वो बीभत्सुपालिताः। हतप्रवीरभूयिष्ठा बभूवुः समवस्थिताः॥
en: Of the sons of Pandu, there were then three Akshauhinis. After the destruction of innumerable heroes, protected by Arjuna, they came to battle.

sa: यस्मादपि समाधिस्ते स्वयमभ्येत्य शोभने। तस्मादुच्छ्वासमासाद्य प्रवक्ष्यामि सरस्वति॥
en: But since, coming of your own accord, O beautiful one, you enter into the engagement, therefore, filling myself with breath, I utter you.

sa: तत्राश्रमपदं धीमान् ब्रह्मर्षिर्लोकपूजितः। मुनिः सत्यवतीपुत्रो धृतराष्ट्रमभाषत॥ धृतराष्ट्र महाबाहो शृणु कौरवनन्दन। श्रुतं ते ज्ञानवृद्धानामृषीणां पुण्यकर्मणाम्॥ श्रद्धाभिजनवृद्धानां वेदवेदाङ्गवेदिनाम्। धर्मज्ञानां पुराणानां वदतां विविधाः कथाः॥
en: Then Satyavati's son, who was honoured by twice-born Rishis and all other person, arrived at the hermitage addressed Dhritarashtra, saying, 'O mighty-armed Dhritarashtra, O son of Kuru's race, listen to what I say! You have heard various discourses from Rishis of great knowledge and sacred deeds, having penances for wealth and excellence of blood, knowledge of the Vedas and their branches, of piety and years, and of great eloquence.

sa: गौतम उवाच अधीत्य वेदांस्त्यजतु त्रीनग्नीनपविध्यतु। विक्रीणातु तथा सोमं बिसस्तैन्यं करोति यः॥ उदपानप्लवे ग्रामे ब्राह्मणो वृषलीपतिः। तस्य सालोक्यतां वातु बिसस्तैन्यं करोति यः।।१२३
en: Gautama said Let him who has stolen the lotusstalks be guilty of throwing away the Vedas after having read them. Let him renounce the three sacred fires. Let him be a seller of the Soma (plant or juice). Let him live with that Brahmana who lives in a village which has only one well from which water is drawn by all classes and who has married a Shudra woman.

sa: स्फाटिकैर्वज्रसारैश्च स्तम्भैः सुकृतवेदिकम्। आरोहति महद् यानं हंससारसनादितम्॥
en: He rides such a car, drawn by swans and cranes, and lives for millions and millions of years in great happiness in Heaven.

sa: न तु जात्या समा लोके ब्राह्मण्याः क्षत्रिया भवेत्। ब्राह्मण्याः प्रथमः पुत्रो भूयान् स्याद् राजसत्तम॥
en: The Kshatriya wife cannot be considered as equal to the Brahmana wife in point of Birth. Hence, O best of kings, the son born of the Brahinani wife must be considered as the first in rank and superior to the son born of the Kshatriya wife.

sa: मन्त्रिणश्चैव कुर्वीथा द्विजान् विद्याविशारदान्॥ विनीतांश्च कुलीनांश्च धर्मार्थकुशलानृजून्।
en: You should made ministers of Brahmanas possessed of learning, endued with humility, well-born, knowing religion and profit, and adorned with simplicity of behaviour.

sa: नित्यमावसथं राजन् नरनारीसमावृतम्। ऋषिरेवं महाभागस्त्वगिरा प्राह धर्मवित्॥
en: That house, O king, is always filled with men and women. This is what the highly blessed Rishi Angirasa, knowing every duty, said.

sa: रक्तपद्मोदयं नाम विमानं साधयेन्नरः। जातरूपप्रयुक्तं च रत्नसंचयभूषितम्॥
en: Such a man gets a car of the colour of the new-blown lotus, adorned with pure gold and heaps of jewels and gems.

sa: दाक्षायण्यास्तथाऽऽदित्यो मनुरादित्यतस्तथा। मनोश्च वंशज इला सुद्युम्नश्च भविष्यति॥
en: From Dakshayani will spring Aditya. and from Aditya will spring Manu. Manu will beget a daughter named Ila and a son named Sudyumna.

sa: तस्य वासवतुल्योऽभून्मरुत्तो नाम वीर्यवान्। पुत्रस्तमनुरक्ताभूत् पृथिवी सागरम्बरा॥
en: He had a son named Marutta, gifted with energy, and resembling Vasava himself. This earth clad in oceans felt herself attracted towards him.

sa: ततस्तामब्रवीद् देवः सुभगे श्रूयतामिति। हेतुभिर्ममैतानि रूपाणि रुचिरानने॥
en: The great god then addressed her, saying. O blessed lady, hear as I explain with the reasons thereof, why my forms are so.

sa: सेवितं सततं राजन् पुरा राजर्षिसत्तमैः। क्षत्रधर्मपरैर्नित्यं सत्यव्रतपरायणैः॥
en: This Mantra, O king, was daily recited by the foremost of royal sages performing Kshatriya duties and steadily observing the vow of truth.

sa: प्रजापतिरिदं सर्वं मनसैवासृजत् प्रभुः। तथैव देवानृषयस्तपसा प्रतिपेदिरे॥
en: The powerful Prajapati created all this by the mind only. Similarly Rishis attained to the status of celestials by the help of penance.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच कथं सदोपवासी स्याद् ब्रह्मचारी च पार्थिव। विघसाशी कथं न स्यात् कथं चैवातिथिप्रियः॥
en: Yuthishthira said How may one come to be considered as always observant of fasts? How may one become observant of vows? How, O king, may one come to be an eater of the residue? By doing what may one be said to be fond of guests.

sa: दत्त्वान्नं विधिवद् राजन् विप्रेभ्यस्त्वमिति प्रभो। यथावदनुरूपेभ्यस्ततः स्वर्गमवाप्स्यसि॥
en: By making gifts of food, O king, worthy Brahinanas with due rites, you may be sure, O powerful one, of attaining to Heaven.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच ब्राह्मणानां हस्तिभिर्नास्ति कृत्यं राजन्यानां नागकुलानि विप्रा स्वं वाहनं नयतो नास्त्यधर्मो नागश्रेष्ठं गौतमास्मान्निवर्त॥
en: Dhritarashtra said Brahmanas have no use for elephants. Indeed, O learned Brahmana, elephants are intended for Kshatriyas. In taking away an animal, viz., this foremost of elephants, for my use, I cannot be considered as committing any sin. Do you cease obstructing me thus, o Gautama.

sa: वस्त्राभरणदातारो भक्तपानान्नदास्तथा। कुटुम्बानां च दातारः पुरुषाः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: Those men who distribute cloths and ornaments, as also food and drink, and who help in marrying others succeed in ascending to heaven.

sa: ततस्ते वनिरश्रेष्ठमभिषेक्तुं यथाविधि। रत्नैर्वस्त्रैश्च भक्ष्यैश्च तोषयित्वा द्विजर्षभान्॥
en: Thereupon those monkeys pleased the foremost of twice-born ones with jewels clothes and eatables, with a view to install that best of monkeys.

sa: प्रेतकार्याणि यान्यस्य कर्तव्यानि विशाम्पतेः। तान्यव्यग्रं महाबाहो क्रियतामविचारितम्॥
en: O mighty armed one, do you without indulging in any reflections, perform those funeral ceremonies of the monarch which ought to be performed.

sa: तस्यैषा धर्मराजस्य धर्ममूला महात्मनः। परिभ्रमति राजश्रीनौरिवाकर्णिका जले॥
en: The royal grace founded in righteousness of that magnanimous and virtuous monarch is wandering even like a boat on water having no helmsman.

sa: तदस्त्रं तस्य वीरस्य स्वर्गमार्गप्रभावनम्। रामबाणासनक्षिप्तमावहत् परमां गतिम्॥
en: The arrow thrown off Răma's bow pointing out to him the way to the celestial region, became an excellent means to that hero.

sa: अत्यन्तसुकुमारस्य तस्य धर्मे कृतात्मनः। कथं रोचयसे वासमरण्येभृशदारुणे॥
en: Why do you like that the exceedingly tender Rāma with his soul established in virtue, should dwell in the woods, undergoing terrible hardship?

sa: निमीलयत चढूंषि सर्वे वानरपुङ्गवाः॥ नहि निष्क्रमितुं शक्यमनिमीलितलोचनैः।
en: You foremost of monkeys, do you close your eyes. No one is able to issue out of this place without closing one's eyes.

sa: योजनानि चतुःषष्टिर्वराहो नाम पर्वतः। सुवर्णशृङ्गः सुमहानगाधे वरुणालये॥
en: Sunk in the depths of the sea, is a very great mountain named Varāha, having golden peaks and measuring four and sixty yojanas.

sa: नात्मन: कामकारो हि पुरुषोऽयमनीश्वरः। इतश्चेतरतश्चैनं कृतान्तः परिकर्षति॥
en: No creature is endowed with the power of exercising any control over the course of events, man has no independent status (in nature).

sa: बहुमूलफलं चित्रमविदूरादितो वनम्। अश्वस्याश्रममेवाहं श्रयिष्ये सगणः पुनः॥
en: Not far from here is a picturesque wood abounding in fruits and roots. Thither shall I betake myself together with my own folks.

sa: स मां दृष्ट्वा नरपतिर्मुष्टिविक्षेपतत्परः। पांसुगुण्ठितसर्वाङ्गी विस्मितो जनकोऽभवत्॥
en: Tending me, with my body covered with dust, Janaka, engaged in throwing handfuls of dust (to level hollow spots), was struck with amazement.

sa: त्वमप्रमेयश्च दुरासदश्च जितेन्द्रियश्चोत्तमधर्मकश्च। अक्षीणकीर्तिश्च विचक्षणश्च क्षितिक्षमावान् क्षतजोपमाक्षः॥
en: You are immeasurable, hard to approach, highly pious, prudent of controlled senses and increasing fame, forgiving like to earth and of blood-red eyes.

sa: कृत्वैतत् कार्मुकं सज्यं हस्तिहस्तमिवापरम्। आकर्णपूर्णमायम्य विसृजस्व महाशरम्॥
en: Having stringed your bow like to the trunk of an elephant and stretching it to your ears, do you shoot this mighty arrow.

sa: तवापि सुमहाभागे जनेन्द्रकुलपूर्वके। बुद्धिमोहः कथमयं सम्भूतस्त्वयि गर्हितः॥
en: And how, O highly exalted lady, O you that born in a royal race, could such reprehensible fatuity take possession of your senses?

sa: अहं तात यथाकालमामिषार्थी खमाप्लुतः। महेन्द्रस्य गिरेरमावृत्य सुसमाश्रितः॥
en: 'Father, taking to my wings at the proper time for procuring flesh, I (went) and stood, obstructing the pass of the Mahendra mountain.

sa: ततः शोकेन संवीतः पितुर्मरणदुःखितः। विललाप महातेजा भ्रान्ताकुलितचेतनः॥
en: Then, overwhelmed with and distressed at the death of his father, that highly sorrow energetic one, with his senses distracted, indulged in lamentations.

sa: तत्रर्षिगणगन्धर्वा वसुधातलवासिनः॥ भवाङ्गपतितं तोयं पवित्रमिति पस्पृशुः ।
en: And there the saints and the Gandharvas, as well as the inhabitants of the earth, touched the sacred water flowing from Bhava's body.

sa: ऊर्ध्वबाहुः पञ्चतपा मासाहारो जितेन्द्रियः। तस्य वर्षसहस्राणि घोरे तपसि तिष्ठतः॥ अतीतानि महाबाहो तस्य राज्ञो महात्मनः।
en: And, O Raghu's descendant, restraining his senses, and eating once a month, and surrounding himself with five fires, and with arms upraised, he for a long lapse of time performed austerities at Gokarna. And as he was performing his terrible austerities, a thousand years rolled away.

sa: तादृशं वालिनः क्षिप्रं प्राकुर्वन्नौदेहिकम्। अङ्गदं परिरभ्याशु तारप्रभृतयस्तथा॥
en: With view to perform the funeral ceremonies of Vāli, the counsellors and other monkeys, having lost their king and embraced Angada, proceeded weeping.

sa: सुखाहँ सुखसंवृद्धं बालमेनमबालिशम्। वाष्पपूर्णमुखं पश्य भूमौ पतितमङ्गदम्॥
en: Do you behold Angada fallen on the ground with tears in his eyes-a little boy, incapable, brought up in luxury and deserving happiness.

sa: नाराजके जनपदे वणिजो दूरगामिनः। गच्छन्ति क्षेममध्वानं बहुपण्यसमाचिताः॥
en: In a kingless country traders coming from distant lands, loaded with various kinds of merchandise, do not with safety go along the roads.

sa: आक्रन्दिता निरानन्दा सास्रकण्ठजनाविला। अयोध्यायामवतता सा व्यतीयाय शर्वरी॥
en: At length the weary night in Ayodhya rendered cheerless cheerless by lamentations, and populous with men with voice choked with tears, was spent.

sa: प्राज्यमूलफलैश्चैव नानाद्विजगणैर्युतः। विविक्तश्च महाबाहो पुण्यो रम्यस्तथैव च॥
en: And that spot abounds in fruits and roots, is frequented by various fowls, is retired, O mighty-armed one, and is sacred and beautiful.

sa: एतदालक्ष्यते वीर मधूकानां महावनम्। उत्तरेणास्य गन्तव्यं न्यग्रोधमपि गच्छता॥ ततः स्थलमुपारुह्य पर्वतस्याविदूरतः। ख्यातः पञ्चवटीत्येव नित्यपुष्पितकाननः॥
en: O hero, yonder is the mighty wood of Madhūkas. Directing your course to the asylum of Nyagrodha trees, go by the north of this Madhūka wood. Then arriving at a spot hard by a hill, (you will) come upon the celebrated Pañcavați, crowned with blossoming woods.

sa: एतैरन्यैश्च बहुभिर्देवि देवसमैः कृतम्। पितुर्वचनमक्लीबं करिष्यामि पितुर्हितम्॥
en: These and other god-like personages, Oh worshipful one, obeyed heroically the orders of their father; and I shall do my father's welfare therefore,

sa: प्राज्यकामा जनपदा: सम्पन्नतरगोरसाः। विचरन्ति महीपाला यात्रार्थं विजिगीषवः॥
en: The provinces overflow with food, and abound in milk and articles prepared therefrom; and kings bent on conquest, range about for surveying thein.

sa: वाष्पच्छन्नान्यरण्यानि यवगोधूमवन्ति च। शोभन्तेऽभ्युदिते सूर्ये नदद्भिः कौञ्चसारसैः॥
en: And the forests enveloped in mist, and stocked with wheat and barley, look brilliant at sunrise, with Krauñcas and cranes crying (in chorus).

sa: अब्रवीच्च वरारोहां चन्द्रचारुनिभाननाम्। विदेहराजस्य सुतां रामो राजीवलोचनः॥
en: And Rāma, furnished with eyes resembling lotuses, addressed the daughter of king Videha, transcendentally beautiful, with a countenance like the fair moon, saying.

sa: आवासमादीपयतां तीर्थं चाप्यवगाहताम्। भाण्डानि चाददानानां घोषस्तु दिवमस्पृशत्॥
en: And the uproar consequent of the troops burning down dwellings, pressing down descents to the river, and loading goods, spread on all sides.

sa: सर्वथा निश्चितार्थोऽयं हनूमति हरीश्वरः। निश्चितार्थतरश्चापि हनूमान् कार्यसाधने॥
en: This lord of monkeys is every way confident concerning Hanumān; and Hanumān himself is even more confident of achieving success in the work.

sa: यस्माद् विप्रेन्द्रमद्राक्षं सुप्रभाता निशा मम। पूर्वं राजर्षिशब्देन तपसा द्योतितप्रभः॥ ब्रह्मर्षित्वमनुप्राप्तः पूज्योऽसि बहुधा मया। तदद्भुतमभूद्विप्र पवित्रं परमं मम॥
en: And truly yesterday night has been succeeded by an auspicious morning, since I have beheld you. Having first attained exceeding effulgence by virtue of austerities performed for obtaining the title of Rājarşi, you have afterwards obtained the status of a Brahmarși. You are worthy of manifold homage from me. This your exceedingly holy arrival appear wonderful.

sa: अहोभिर्दशभिर्ये च नागच्छन्ति ममाज्ञया। हन्तव्यास्ते दुरात्मानो राजशासनदूषकाः॥
en: Those wicked ones, that finding fault with the royal mandate, do not (come in) at my command within ten days, must be slain.

sa: अनेन त्वां हरि श्रेष्ठ चिह्वेन जनकात्मजा। मत्सकाशादनुप्राप्तमनुद्विग्नाऽनुपश्यति॥
en: By this sign, O foremost of monkeys, Janaka's daughter will be able to see you fearlessly, as one that has come from me.

sa: ततो गृहीते प्रेष्याभ्यामशोभेतां तदायुधे। मालादामभिरासक्ते सीतया समलंकृते॥
en: The two looked beautiful with a couple of handmaids (following them), taking the weapons that had been decked by Sītā with flowery wreaths.

sa: पन्नागाशनमाकाशे पतन्तं पक्षिसेवितम्। वैनतेयमहं शक्तः परिगन्तुं सहस्रशः॥
en: And for once that lor birds, Vinata's offspring, living on serpents, courseth through the welkin, I can course through it a thousand times.

sa: दरिद्राय द्विजायाथ हस्ताभरणमुत्तमम्॥ कस्मैचिद् याचमानाय ददौ राघवनन्दनः।
en: Then to a certain poor twice-born one that asked for gifts, the descendant of Raghu gave an excellent ornament from his own arm.

sa: प्रतिलोमानुलोमाश्च रुचिरा रोमराजयः। शोभन्ते मृगमाश्रित्य चित्राः कनकबिन्दुभिः॥
en: The hairs of its body being arranged in regular and contrary courses and being painted with golden drops do indeed look very beautiful.

sa: पश्यास्य जृम्भमाणस्य दीप्तामग्निशिखोपमाम्। जिह्वां मुखानिःसरन्तीं मेघादिव शतहदाम्॥
en: Do you see, while expanding its inouth, its tongue comes out resembling flaming fire like to a thunder-bolt reaving the mass of clouds.

sa: विसर्जयित्वा तान् विप्रान् सचिवानिदमब्रवीत्॥ ऋत्विग्भिरुपसंदिष्टो यथावत् क्रतुराप्यताम्।
en: Dismissing those Brāhmaṇas, the king spoke to his ministers, saying, Do you, even as the family priests have ordered, arrange for the sacrifice!

sa: तां क्लिष्टमाल्याभरणां विलपन्तीमनाथवत्। अभ्यधावत वैदेहीं रावणो राक्षसाधिपः॥
en: Thereat, that lord of the Rākşasas, Rāvana, darted towards Vaidehi, who, with a faded wreath for her ornament, was bewailing in forlorn guise.

sa: नष्टज्वलनसंतापा प्रशान्ताध्यायसत्कथा। तिमिरेणानुलिप्तेव तदा सा नगरी बभौ॥
en: The city became enveloped in darkness, and the light of the sacrificial fires) extinguished, and the sounds of study and edifying discourse ceased.

sa: आत्मनश्चापनयनं मृगरूपेण रक्षसा॥ आजगाम जनस्थानं राघवः परिशङ्कितः।
en: Rāghava went back to Janasthāna, alarmed in consequence of his having been drawn away by the Raksasa in the form of a dear.

sa: दिव्यदुन्दुभिनिर्घोषं तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणम्। सोपानं काञ्चनं चित्रमारुरोह तथा सह॥
en: Rāvana in company with Şītā ascended the beautiful golden stairs, resounding with the sounds of kettle-drums and embellished with ornaments of burnished gold.

sa: राघवप्रत्ययार्थं तु दुन्दुभेः कायमुत्तमम्। दर्शयामास सुग्रीवो महापर्वतन्निभम्॥
en: And with the view of convincing Raghava (as to Vali's might), Sugriva showed to him the huge corpse of Dundubhi, resembling a hill.

sa: शिलाः शैलस्य शोभन्ते विशालाः शतशोऽभितः। बहुला बहुलैर्वर्णैनीलपीतसितारुणैः॥
en: The giant crags of the mountain grace the place all round by hundreds; many and varioushued, blue and yellow and pale and red.

sa: शब्दापिहितकण्ठश्च शोधनार्थमुपागतः। चितामूले पितुर्वाक्यमिदमाह सुदुःखितः॥ तात यस्मिन् निसृष्टोऽहं त्वया भ्रातरि राघवे। तस्मिन् वनं प्रव्रजिते शून्ये त्यक्तोऽस्म्यहं त्वया॥
en: And coming to the foot of the funeral pyre for gathering the bones of the departed, he overcome with grief, with his throat obstructed with the sounds of lamentation, said, “my father, on brother Rāma, to whom I had been consigned by you, having gone to the forest, I have been cast by you into vacancy.

sa: स निमित्तैश्च दृष्टार्थोः कारणैश्च महागुणैः। ऋषिवाक्यैश्च हनुमानभवत्प्रीतमानसः॥
en: And what through the auspicious omens that he had witnessed, and what through the speech of the saints, Hanumān was delighted (beyond measure).

sa: यश्चेदं श्रावयेच्छ्राद्धे ब्राह्मणान् पादमन्ततः। अक्षय्यमन्नपानं वै पितृस्तस्योपतिष्ठते॥
en: The departed manes of that man who recites even a small portion of this history at a Shraddha obtain inexhaustible food and drink.

sa: हारैर्निष्कैः सकेयूरैः शिरोभिश्च सकुण्डलैः। उष्णीषैरपविद्धैश्च पताकाभिश्च सर्वशः॥
en: With garlands and necklaces of gold, with heads graced with ear-rings, with bracelets, with head-gears fallen off from the heads, and with streamers,

sa: ततः खङ्गास्त्रिशूलांश्च तोमरांश्च सहस्रशः। अस्त्रवीर्येण शतधा तैर्मुक्तानहमच्छिदम्॥
en: Then by the power of that weapon, I cut, to a hundred pieces, the swords, tridents and thousands of Tomaras hurled by them.

sa: शारद्वतशरैर्ग्रस्तं विश्यमानं महाबलः। चित्रकेतुसुतो राजन् सुकेतुस्त्वरितो ययौ॥
en: O king, Chitraketu's son Suketu quickly proceeded towards the highly powerful (Shikhandin) who was thus distressed and assailed by the son of Sharadvata.

sa: आह्वयेलोकपालांस्त्रीन् देवाशक्रपुरोगमान्। आतिथ्यं कर्तुमिच्छामि तत्र मे संविधीयताम्॥
en: I invoke the three guardians of the worlds, gods headed by Sakra. I wish to entertain guests. Let them accomplish this for me,

sa: देवि हयृक्षसैन्यानामीश्वरः प्लवतां वरः। सुग्रीवः सत्यसम्पन्नस्तवार्थे कृतनिश्चयः॥
en: O revered lady, that foremost of monkeysthe lord of bears and monkeys-Sugrīva, possessed of truth, has made up his mind on your behalf.

sa: न शक्या यज्ञमध्यस्था वेदिः स्रुग्भाण्डमण्डिता। द्विजातिमन्त्रसम्पूता चण्डालेनावमर्दितुम्॥
en: A Candāla cannot tread the dais reared the midst of a sacrifice beauteous with ladies, and vessels, and sanctified by the twice-born ones.

sa: गृहेष्वेते न पापाय तथा वै तैलपायिकाः॥ उद्वीपकाश्च गृध्राश्च कपोता भ्रमरास्तथा। निवेशेयुर्यदा तत्र शान्तिमेव तदाऽऽचरेत्। अमङ्गल्यानि चैतानि तथाक्रोशो महात्मनाम्॥ महात्मनोऽतिगुह्यानि न वक्तव्यानि कर्हिचित्। अगम्याश्च न गच्छेत राज्ञः पत्नी सखीस्तथा॥
en: If these live in one's house, they succeed in removing calamity. The same is the case with cockroaches. If fireflies and vultures and woodpigeons and bees enter a house and live in it, acts of propitiating the celestials should be performed. These are creatures of evil omen, as also ospreys. One should never give out the secrets of great men; one should never have sexual union with a forbidden woman. Nor should one ever have such union with the consort of a king or with women who are the friends of qucens.

sa: तवाप्येवं हतसुता निहतज्ञातिबान्धवाः। स्त्रियः परिपतिष्यन्ति यथैता भरतस्त्रियः॥
en: The ladies of your family, deprived of sons, kinsmen, and friends, shall weep and cry even as these ladies of the Bharata family.

sa: तं व्रजन्तं मुनिवरमन्वगादनुसारिणाम्। शकटीशतमात्रं तु प्रयाणे ब्रह्मवादिनाम्॥
en: And as that best of ascetics proceeded, he was followed by Brāhmaṇas, unholding the Veda, carrying the sacrificial necessaries on an hundred cars.

sa: हायिहायिहुवाहायिहावुहायि तथासकृत्। गायन्ति त्वां सुरश्रेष्ठ सामगा ब्रह्मवादिनः॥
en: O foremost of all goods, those Brahmavadins who sing the Samans always sing you when they utter the syllables HayiHayi, Huva-Hayi, and Huva-Hoyi.

sa: भगवन्क्व विमुञ्चामि तरोः शाखामिमामहम्। वर्जितं मानुषैर्देशमाख्यातु भगवान्मम॥
en: "O illustrious one, where stall I throw this great bough of the tree? O illustrious one, point me a place free from men."

sa: प्रोवाच चैनम् 'अयमस्मि, अत्र केदारखण्डे निःसरमाणमुदकमवारणीयं संरोद्धं संविष्टः, भगवच्छब्दं श्रुत्वैव, सहसा विदार्य केदारखण्डम्, भवन्तमुपस्थितः। तदभिवादये भगवन्तम्, आज्ञापयतु भवान् कमर्थं करवाणि इति॥२९-३०॥
en: Addressing his preceptor Aruni said. “I was in the breach of the water-course. Having been unable to stop it by and other means, I entered myself into the breach to prevent the water from running out. It is only when I heard your honour's voice that I have left it and allowed the waters to escape. I salute you, great teacher, tell me what I am to do now.

sa: तेहन्यमाना वीरेणम्लेच्छाः सात्यकिना रणे॥ शतशोऽभ्यपतंस्तत्र व्यसवो बसुधातले।
en: Thus slaughtered by the heroic Satyaki in that haitle, the Mlechchas began to fall by inundreds on the ground deprived of their lives.

sa: छायाश्च विपुला दृष्ट्वा देवगन्धर्वरक्षसाम्॥ गन्धर्वाणां ततस्तीर्थमागच्छद् रोहिणीसुतः।
en: He also saw there many shadows of gods, Gandharvas and Rakshasas. The son of Rohini then proceeded to the tirtha of the Gandharvas.

sa: कृताञ्जलिरुपातिष्ठदभिवाद्याथ पाण्डवान्। ब्राह्मणांश्च महाबाहुः स च तैरभिनन्दितः॥
en: The mighty armed hero, after saluting the Pandavas and the Brahmanas, stood before them with joined hands. They too welcomed him in return.

sa: जाम्बूनदमया यूपाः सर्वे रत्नपरिच्छदाः। गयस्यासन् समृद्धास्तु सर्वभूतमनोहराः॥
en: In the sacrifices of Gaya, the stakes were made of gold; and embossed with jewels and precious, they delighted the hearts of all.

sa: ततोऽपश्यत् कुथासीनं नानावर्णाम्बरस्रजम्। सहस्रं वरनारीणां नानावेषविभूषितम्॥ परिवृत्तेऽर्धरात्रे तु पाननिद्रावसंगतम्। क्रीडित्वोपरतं रात्रौ प्रसुप्तं बलवत् तदा॥
en: And when the night had been half spent, (Hanuman) saw thousands of superb dames, adorned in various attires, and bearing apparels of diverse hues, and wreaths, who having given up sport, and come under the influence of wine and sleep, were fast asleep on woollen sheets.

sa: त्वत्प्रसादात् सुराः सर्वे मोदन्तीहाकुतोभयाः। एवं स्तुत्वा महादेवभूषिर्वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: It is through your favour that the celestials sport without anxiety or fear.” Having thus adored Mahadeva, the Rishi thus spoke to him;

sa: भूरिश्रवाश्छिन्नबाहुयुद्धे प्रायगतस्त्वया। वधेन सुनृशंसेन कथं वीरेण पातितः॥
en: Professing yourself to be a hero, how could you so cruelly kill the armless Bhurishravas who, on the field of battle, sat fasting.

sa: काञ्चनोष्णीषिणस्तत्र वेत्रझर्झरपाणयः। प्रोत्सारयन्तः शनकैस्तं जनं सर्वतो दिशम्॥
en: Shone resplendent like the surrounded by blazing mighty planets. Then attendants, graced with golden turbans, and bearing canes and Jharjharas in their hands,

sa: मुनेर्वचनमक्लीबं श्रुत्वा नरवरात्मजः। राघवः प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा प्रत्युवाच दृढव्रतः॥
en: Hearing those bold words of the ascetic, the son of that foremost of men, Rāghava firm in his vows, with clasped hands answered.

sa: ततो धर्मार्थकामानां कुशलः प्रतिभानवान्। राजधर्मविधानज्ञः प्रत्युवाच पुरंदरम्॥
en: Thus addressed, Brihaspati, skilled in Virtue, Profit, and Pleasure, endued with a knowledge of royal duties, and great intelligence, answered Indra as follows.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा फलैर्मूलैः पुष्पैरन्यैश्च राघवम्। वन्यैश्च विविधाहारैः सलक्ष्मणमपूजयन्॥
en: Having said this, they entertained Rāghava, along with Laksmana, with fruits and roots and flowers and diverse other edibles procurable in the woods.
