sa: ते वृक्षानुदकं भूमिमाश्रमेषूटजांस्तथा। न हिंस्युरिति तेनाहमेक एवागतस्ततः॥
en: That these might not injure trees or water or the grounds of the cottages pertaining to the asylums, have I come hither alone.

sa: व्यावृत्ततिलकाः काश्चित् काश्चिदुद्भ्रान्तनूपुराः। पार्वे गलितहाराश्च काश्चित् परमयोषितः॥
en: And some of those paragons had got their beauty-spots, smudged; and some, their bangles loosening off, some, their chains running to one side.

sa: नवमेघप्रतीकाशाश्चाक्षिप्य तुरगान् गजाः। पादैरेव विमृद्नन्ति मत्ताः कनकभूषणाः॥
en: Many infuriated elephants adorned with gold trappings and loO king like newly-risen clouds threw down the horses and crushed them with their legs.

sa: सिताभ्रशिखरप्रख्यं प्रासादमधिरुह्य च। समीयाय नरेन्द्रेण शक्रेणेव बृहस्पतिः॥
en: And ascending the palace like to a peak of the Himavat, he met with the lord of men, like Bệhaspati meeting with Sakra.

sa: सोऽपश्यत्तन्नरेन्द्रस्तु नश्यमानं महाबलम्। महार्णवं समासाद्य वनापगशतं यथा॥
en: He saw the mighty army of that powerful monarch destroyed by the (adversary), like to a hundred streams absorbed by an approaching ocean.

sa: द्रौपद्युवाच रनायुष्यं कर्म कृत्वातिघोरम्। एते वीराः पतयो मे समेता न वः शेषः कश्चिदिहास्ति युद्धे॥
en: Draupadi said : "Having committed such an henious deed that will shorter your life, of what use, O fool, it will be now to know the names of those great heroes; as my heroic husbands have come, none of you shall be left alive in battle.

sa: प्रेषिता धर्मराजेन भीमसेनपदानुगाः। प्रतिजग्मुर्महाराज तव पुत्रान् महाबलान्॥
en: And being dispatched by the very virtuous king Yudhishthira to follow behind Bhima, encounter, O mighty monarch, your princely sons, all excellent car-warrior.

sa: कच्चिच्च लक्ष्मणः शूरः सुमित्रानन्दवर्धनः। अस्त्रविच्छरजालेन राक्षसान् विधमिष्यति॥
en: Will not the heroic Lakşmaņa, the enhancer of Sumitrā's joy, conversant with the use of weapons, burn down the Rākşasas with this shafts?

sa: ततो मुनिवरः प्रीतस्ताटकावधतोषितः।३२।। मूर्ध्नि राममुपाघ्राय इदं वचनमब्रवीत्।
en: And now came evening on, when that best of ascetics, gratified at the destruction of Tāțakā, smelt Rāma's crown and said these words,

sa: अन्योन्यस्याङ्गसंस्पर्शात् प्रीयमाणाः सुमध्यमाः। एकीकृतभुजाः सर्वाः सुषुपुस्तत्र योषितः॥
en: Those females having elegant waists, receiving pleasure from the contact with others' persons, were sleeping there, with their hands fastened by each other.

sa: ततः संदर्शने तस्य भरद्वाजस्य राघवः। मन्त्रिणस्तानवस्थाप्य जगामानुपुरोहितम्॥
en: Then with the view of seeing Bharadvāja, that descendent of Raghu leaving behind the counsellors also, went in the wake of the priest.

sa: तत: किलकिलाशब्दः क्षणेन समभूत् तदा॥ मत्स्यपाञ्चालचेदीनां तमेकमभिधावताम्।
en: Then as the Matsyas, the Panchalas and the Chedis rushed against that single-handed warrior, loud became the din and confusion that then arose.

sa: स एवमुक्तः प्रत्युवाच-'नानृतमूचतुर्भगवन्तौ न त्वहमेतमपूपमुपयोक्तुमुत्सहे गुरवेऽनिवेद्य' इति॥
en: Thus addressed he replied, “O Ashvinis, your words never prove untrue. But I cannot take this cake without offering it to my preceptor.

sa: वानराधिपतिः श्रीमान् सुग्रीवः कच्चिदेष्यति। मत्कृते हरिभिवीरैर्वृतो दन्तनखायुधैः॥
en: Will not the graceful Sugrīva, the lord of the monkeys come to help ine with hosts of monkeys having huge teeth and nails?

sa: गरुडव्यूहमास्थाय सर्वतो हरिभिर्वृतः। मां विसृज्य महातेजा लङ्कामेवातिवर्तते॥
en: And, letting me off, that one of suspassing vigour, surrounded by monkeys, and, arranging his forces in the Garuda fashion, advance upon Lanka.

sa: कच्चिन्न विगतस्नेहो विवासान्मयि राघवः। कच्चिन्मां व्यसनादस्मान्मोक्षयिष्यति राघवः॥
en: Has Rāghava lost all his affection for me for my living at a distance from him? Will he save me from this disaster?

sa: ग्रहीतुकामं दृष्ट्वा तं पुनरेवाभ्यधावत। तत्क्षणादेव संत्रासात् पुनरन्तर्हितोऽभवत्॥
en: And Rama desirous of taking (the beast), seeing him again, set off at speed. At the very moment the deer disappeared from fear,

sa: नानादेशगताश्चैव ब्राह्मणाः संशितव्रताः। सीताशपथवीक्षार्थ सर्व एव समागताः॥ तदा समागतं सर्वमश्मभूतमिवाचलम्। श्रुत्वा मुनिवरस्तूर्णं ससीतः समुपागमत्।९॥
en: Besides thousands and thousands of Kșatriyas, Vaiśyas, sadras and Brāhmaṇas of firm tenancies, also hailed there from various parts to witness Sita's trial. Having arrived there they all sat down motionless like mountains. There upon, Valmiki, the foremost of ascetics, speedily came there accompanied by Sitā.

sa: तदित्यनभिसंधाय फलं यज्ञतप:क्रियाः। दानक्रियाश्च विविधा क्रियन्ते मोक्षकाक्षिभिः॥
en: Uttering TAT, the various sacrifices, gifts and penances are performed by those who desire emancipation, and who do not without expectation of fruit.

sa: स्थिताऽहं बालभावेन तत्र दोषमबुद्ध्यती। अथ देवः सहस्रांशुमत्समीपगतोऽभवत्॥
en: Without any consciousness of the fault I committed, I called the deity from mere childishness. The deity, of a thousand rays, before me.

sa: वीतरागश्च पुत्रस्ते परमात्मा भविष्यति। महेश्वरप्रसादेन नैतद् वचनमन्यथा॥
en: Your son, however, will be freed from every attachment like the Supreme Soul, through the favour of Mahadeva. It will not be otherwise.

sa: कुशिकस्यात्मजः श्रीमान् गाधिर्नाम जनेश्वरः। अपुत्रः प्रसवेनार्थी वनवासमुपावसत्॥
en: Kushika's son was the illustrious king Gadhi who, being childless and wishing to have a son born to him, went to the forest.

sa: तमेकमनसं यान्तमव्यग्रमकुतोभयम्। ददृशुः सर्वभूतानि जङ्गमानि चराणि च॥
en: Indeed, all creatures, mobile and immobile, cast their eyes upon him as he went with rapt attention, and a tranquil and fearless soul.

sa: सर्वतःश्रुतिमाल्लोके सर्वमावृत्य तिष्ठसि। फलं त्वमसि तिग्मांशोर्निमेषादिषु कर्मसु॥
en: You are the fruit of all acts which are performed in the Nimeshas and other divisions of time which originate from the Sun.

sa: एतदेवमवश्यं हि भविता नैतदन्यथा। क्रियतामनवद्याङ्गि यथोक्तं मद्वचोऽनघे॥
en: This must surely take place. It cannot be otherwise. O sinless one, O fair lady do you satisfy the order I have given.

sa: व्याघ्रसिंहमृगाणां च तरक्ष्वृक्षपतत्रिणाम्। उलूकश्वशृगालानां रूपाणि कुरुतेऽपि च॥
en: He assumes the forms of tigers and lions and deer, of wolves and bears and birds, of owls and of jackals as well.

sa: तमापतन्तं सहसा दृष्ट्वा सर्वाप्सरोगणाः॥ सम्भ्रान्तमनसो राजन्नासन् परमविस्मिताः।
en: Seeing him coming in that way, all the tribes of the Apsaras, struck with fear O king, became filled with surprise. Heáeçet[eDeYerle-ees Ye=MeceglHeÂguueesdeveeim~19~~

sa: स्त्रियः पुरुषवेषेण पुंसः स्त्रीवेषधारिणः॥ क्रीडारतिविहारेषु परां मुदमवाप्नुवन्।
en: They began to derive great pleasure from sports and plays in which their women were dressed as men and their men as women.

sa: ततस्तयोर्वधेनाशु वेदापहरणेन च। शोकापनयनं चक्रे ब्रह्मणः पुरुषोत्तमः॥
en: Having brought about the destruction of the two Asuras and restored the Vedas to Brahman, the Supreme Being removed the sorrow of Brahman.

sa: युवानश्च समासीना वृद्धानपि गतान् सतः। नाभ्युत्थानाभिवादाभ्यां यथापूर्वमपूजयन्॥
en: When reverend elders came, the younger individuals, scated at their ease, refused to worship the former by rising up and saluting them respectfully.

sa: वासुदेवस्तदोवाच पुनर्मतिमतां वरः। सुवर्णाक्षो महादेवस्तपसा तोषितो मया॥
en: After this, Vasudeva, that foremost of all intelligent men, once more said Mahadeva of golden eyes was pleased by me with my penances.

sa: भूतानि च महाराज नानारूपधराण्यथ। राक्षसाश्च महारौद्राः पिशाचाश्च महाबलाः॥ बहुरूपधरा हृष्टा नानाप्रहरणोद्यताः। देवस्यानुचरास्तत्र तस्थिरे चानलोपमाः॥
en: Many ghosts also, of various forms and aspects, and many fearful Rakshasas and powerful Pishachas, of various forms, mad with joy, and armed with various sorts of uplifted weapons forming the train of Mahadeva, were there, every one of whom looked like a blazing fire energy.

sa: मेरुशृङ्गे किल पुरा कर्णिकारवनायुते। विजहार महादेवो भीमैर्भूतगणैर्वृतः॥
en: Once on a time on the summit of Meru adorned with Karnikara flowers, Mahadeva sported, in company of his followers, the terrible spirits.

sa: तयोर्ये त्वन्वये जाता भविष्यन्ति वनौकसः। महाबला महावीर्याः शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमाः॥ ते सहाया भविष्यन्ति सुरकार्ये मम द्विज।
en: Those monkeys that shall take birth in the race of Ekata and Dvita, shall become endued with great power and mighty energy and will equal Shakra himself in power. All those monkeys, O twice-born one, will become my allies for performing the work of the gods.

sa: वर्णतो गुह्यते चापि कामात् पिबति चाशयान्। न चास्य तेजसा रूपं दृश्यते शाम्यते तथा। अहङ्कारेऽस्य विजिते पञ्चैते स्युर्वशानुगाः॥
en: By mastering over Water, one can drink up rivers, lakes, and oceans. By mastering over Fire, the Yogin becomes so effulgent that his form cannot be spied. He becomes visible only when he puts out the fire within him. When the Yogin succeeds in destroying the consciousness of Ego, these five elements come within his control.

sa: दीर्घकालेन तपसा सेवितेन महामते। धर्मनिर्धूतपापानां संसिध्यन्ते मनोरथाः॥
en: O you of great intelligence, the desires and purposes of those whose sins have been purged off by long-continued penances wellperformed, become fruitful.

sa: अरिष्टानि प्रवक्ष्यामि विहितानि मनीषिभिः। संवत्सरवियोगस्य सम्भवन्ति शरीरिणः॥
en: I shall now tell you the presaging marks, as laid down by the wise, of those who have but one year to live.

sa: व्ययगुणमपि साधुं कर्मणा संश्रयन्ते भवति मनुजलोकाद् देवलोको विशिष्टः। बहुतरसुसमृद्ध्या मानुषाणां गृहाणि। पितृवनभवनाभं दृश्यते चामराणाम्॥
en: The good man who is prodigal is sought by the gods for his good conduct, the celestial world being better than the world of men, but the house of miser though full of riches is looked upon by the gods as the house of the dead.

sa: अमानुषीषु गोवामनावृष्टिर्न दुष्यति। अधिष्ठात्रवमन्तारं पशूनां पुरुषं विदुः॥
en: By killing animals except a cow, the killer is not stained. The learned hold that man has supremacy over all the lower animals.

sa: जङ्गमानां हि सर्वेषां स्थावराणां तथैव च। आकाशं पवनोऽन्वेति ज्योतिस्तमनुगच्छति। तेषां त्रयाणामेकत्वाद् द्वयं भूमौ प्रतिष्ठितम्॥
en: The breath that exists in all mobile and immobile objects mingles with space, and the heat which is in them follows that breath. These three (viz., space, air, and fair), mingle together. The other two (viz., water and earth), exist together in the shape of earth.

sa: स्वर्गलोको गृहस्थानां प्रतिष्ठा नियतात्मनाम्। ब्रह्मणा विहिता योनिरेषा यस्माद् विधीयते। द्वितीयं क्रमशः प्राप्य स्वर्गलोके महीयते॥
en: The regions of heaven form the high mead for all householders of controlled minds. The Self-born Brahma ordained that the domestic life, should secure heaven, and since it has been so ordained, a person, by gradually following the second mode of life, obtains happiness in heaven.

sa: तत् सुपर्णार्कचरितमास्थितं वैष्णवं पदम्। भाभिरप्रतिमं भाति त्रैलोक्यमवभासयत्॥
en: Riding upon Vishnu's vehicle adorned with Garuda and Surya himself, that object shone forth with matchless splendour and seemed to the three worlds.

sa: विश्वामित्रोऽपि भगवांस्तपसा दग्धकिल्बिषः। कालेन महता सिद्धिमवाप परमाद्भुताम्॥
en: However, having completed the rites in honour of the gods and the Pitris and having pleased them duly, Vishvamitra, himself took that meat.

sa: बृहस्पति देवगुरुं सुरासुराः सर्वे समेत्याभ्यनुयुज्य राजन्। धर्म्यं फलं वेत्थ फलं महर्षे तथैव तस्मिन्नरके पारलोक्ये॥
en: Approaching, in days of yore, the celestial preceptor Brihaspati, the gods and Asuras, O king, humbly enquired of him, saying,-You are cognisant, O great Rishi, of the fruits of virtue, as also the fruits of those other acts which lead to hell in the next world.

sa: सर्वे जीवाः प्राणिनां प्राणनान्ते गत्वा वृत्ताः संनिवृत्तास्तथैव। एवं सर्वे मानवाः प्राणनान्ते गत्वा वृत्ताः देववद्राजसिंह॥
en: As the senses of all creatures disappear when they are in dreamless slumber and return once more when they awake, similarly, upon the dissolution of their bodies, all human beings have to go into the other world and return thence to this, O foremost of kings.

sa: वसुर्यज्ञशतैरिष्ट्वा द्वितीय इव वासवः। मिथ्याभिधानेनैकेन रसातलतलं गतः॥
en: Vasu, though he celebrated a hundred sacrifices, like a second Vasava, was sent to the nethermost regions, for making a single false statement.

sa: बलिवैरोचनिर्बद्धो धर्मपाशेन दैवतैः। विष्णोः पुरुषकारेण पातालसदनः कृतः॥
en: Bali, the son of Virochana, virtuous bound by his promise, was sent to the regions under the Earth, by the prowess of Vishnu.

sa: तस्यानुगतमूलस्य मूलमुध्रियते बलात्। योगप्रसादात् कृतिना साम्येन परमासिना॥
en: However, by the help of Yoga, a clever man forcibly cuts off with the sword of concentration, the far-reaching root of this tree.

sa: स तमोनुद इत्युक्तः सर्वज्ञैर्वेदपारगैः। विमलो वितमस्कश्च निर्लिङ्गोऽलिङ्गसंज्ञितः॥
en: Persons conversant with the Vedas and endued with omniscience call Him the remover of Darkness, stainless, above Darkness, and with and without attributes.

sa: कामेन युक्ता ऋषयस्तपस्येव समाहिताः। पलाशफलमूलादा वायुभक्षाः सुसंयताः॥
en: It is under the influence of Desire that the very Rishis practise penances, living upon fruits, or living upon roots or air only.

sa: चरिष्यमाण इन्द्रोतं शौनकं संशितव्रतम्। समासाद्योपजग्राह पादयोः परिपीडयन्॥
en: One day, in course of his peregrinations, he met Indrota, the son of Shunaka, of rigid vows, and approaching him touched his feet.

sa: प्रवृत्तिलक्षणं धर्मं प्रजापतिरथाब्रवीत्। प्रवृत्तिः पुनरावृत्तिनिवृत्तिः परमा गतिः॥
en: The Creator (Brahman) has described the religion of inclination. Inclination indicates rebirth or return. Disinclination on the other hand, indicates the highest end.

sa: वल्लभस्तस्य तनयः साक्षाद्धर्म इवापरः। कुशिकस्तस्य तनयः सहस्त्राक्षसमद्युतिः॥
en: His son was named Vallabha who was like a second Dharina incarnate. His son was Kushika who was illustrious like the thousandeyed Indra.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। गीतं विदेहराजेन माण्डव्यायानुपृच्छते॥
en: Bhishma said Regarding it is cited the old narrative of what was said by the king of the Videhas to the enquiring Mandavya.

sa: अदान्तः पुरुषः क्लेशमभीक्ष्णं प्रतिपद्यते। अनर्थांश्च बहूनन्यान् प्रसृजत्यात्मदोषजान्॥
en: The man who is without self-control always suffers misery. Such a man brings upon himself many calamities all begotten by his own faults.

sa: ततः कदाचित् स मुनिर्वर्षास्वाकाशमास्थितः। अन्तरिक्षाज्जलं मूर्धा प्रत्यगृह्णान्मुहुर्मुहुः॥
en: On one occasion that ascetic, while standing under the sky during the rainy season, received on his head repeated showers froin the clouds.

sa: अचेष्टमानमासीनं श्री: कञ्चिदुपतिष्ठते। कश्चित् कर्मानुसृत्यान्यो न प्राप्यमधिगच्छति॥
en: Some one who sits idly, acquires great prosperity; while another, by working earnestly, is seen to miss desirable fruits almost within his reach.

sa: यूयं तैह्रियमाणाश्च मोक्षिता दृढधन्वना। निवातकवचाश्चापि देवानां शत्रवस्तथा॥
en: You also were set free from the bondage to the Gandharvas by that resolute bowman. The Nivtakavachas and other enemies of the gods.

sa: तौ शोणितोक्षितैर्गात्रैः शरैश्छिन्नमनुच्छदौ। कर्णभीमौ व्यराजेतां निर्मुक्ताविव पन्नगौ॥
en: Then Karna and Bhima, with their bodies steeped in blood and armour shattered with arrows appeared beautiful like snakes freed from their sloughs.

sa: वारणाविव चान्योन्यं विषाणाभ्यामरिंदमौ। निर्भिन्दन्तौ स्वगात्राणि सायकैश्चारु रेजतुः॥
en: Like two elephants goring each other with their tusks, those two subduers of foes mangling each other with their shafts, appeared highly beautiful.

sa: सिंहनादरवाश्चासशङ्खशब्दविमिश्रिताः। दृष्ट्वा दुर्योधनं तत्र कृष्णयोः प्रमुखे स्थितम्॥
en: Then beholding Duryodhana stay, facing the two Krishna's, your troops uttered warcries resembling leonine roars that became mingled with the blare of conchs.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच राजा श्रान्तो विक्षतो दुःखितश्च कर्णेन संख्ये निशितैबार्णसंधैः। यश्चानिशं सूतपुत्रेण वीर शरैर्भृशं ताडितोऽयुध्यमानः॥
en: Vasudeva said-"O valiant one, the King Yudhishthira feels weary and aggrieved on being afflicted with arrows shot at him by Karna during the campaign; the more so as he was harassed with shaft-shots by the son of Suta even when he was retiring form the field.

sa: दुःशासनः षोडशभिर्विव्याध शिनिपुङ्गवम्। शकुनिः पञ्चविंशत्या चित्रसेनश्च पञ्चभिः॥
en: Then Dushasana pierced that foremost scion of the Sini dynasty with sixteen shafts, Shakuni pierced him with twenty-five and Chitrasena with five arrows.

sa: द्रोणमेवाभ्यवर्तन्त पुरस्कृत्य शिखण्डिनम्। तथेतरे नरव्याघ्राः पाण्डवानां महारथाः॥
en: With Shikhandi at their head, marched against Drona. Similarly (numerous) other foremost of men and mighty car-warriors on the side of the Pandavas.

sa: अन्योन्यमभिवीक्षन्तौ कोपाद् विवृतलोचनौ। प्रहसन्तौ तथान्योन्यं भर्त्सयन्तौ मुहुर्मुहुः॥
en: Sometimes they laughed at each other, sometimes reproached each other and sometimes blew their conchs; and in this was they went on fighting.

sa: योजितः पार्थिवः शूरैः समथैवीर्यशालिभिः॥ दुर्योधनस्य वृद्ध्यर्थं कृत्स्त्रामुर्वीमथाजयत्।
en: Having been unsubdued by the heroic and mightest monarchs of immense prowess, he then subjugated the entire earth for the aggrandisement of Duryodhana.

sa: पञ्चाला: सृञ्जया मत्स्याश्चेदिकारुषकोसलाः। अन्वगच्छन् महाराज केकयाश्च महारथाः॥
en: The Panchalas, the Srinjayas, the Matsyas, the Chedis, the Kauravas, the Kosalas and those mighty car-warriors, the Keykayas followed suit, O great king.

sa: गृहीत्वा धनुरन्यत्तु शल्यो विव्याध पाण्डवम्। भूरिश्रवास्त्रिभिर्बाणैर्हेमपुङ्खः शिलाशितैः॥
en: Thereupon taking another bow Shalya began to pierce Pandu's son. Then Bhurishrava with three arrows furnished with golden wings and whetted on stone.

sa: ततोऽश्मवृष्टिरत्यर्थमासीत् तत्र समन्ततः। संध्याकालाधिकबलैः प्रयुक्ता राक्षसैः क्षितौ॥
en: Hurled by the Rakshasa who became more powerful on night-fall, there began to fall from all sides showers of stones on the ground.

sa: व्याकुलीकृतमर्थ परसैन्य किरीटिना। नानामृगसहस्राणां यूथं केसरिणां यथा॥
en: Arjuna, the crown holder has made impatient to the army of enemy as a lion becomes cause for anxiety to several thousand stags.

sa: प्रहरध्वमितः सर्वे मम गात्रे महारथाः॥ स्थिरीभूताश्च युद्ध्यध्वंदर्शयन्तोऽस्रलाघवम्।
en: All of you, O mighty car-warriors, strike me in the body and displaying your dexterity in handling weapons engage in battle with calmness.

sa: केकयांश्चैव चेदींश्च बहुभिर्निशितैः शरैः। सात्वतं पञ्चभिर्विद्धवा द्रौपदेयांसिभिस्रिभिः॥
en: And the Kalkeyas and the Chedies with numerous keen darts. piercing Satvatta with five (arrows), each of the son of Draupadi with three.

sa: भीमसेनपुरोगास्तु पञ्चालाः समुपाद्रवन्। स भीमसेनं दशभिर्माद्रीपुत्रौ त्रिभिस्त्रिभिः॥
en: The Panchalas led by Bhimasena advanced (against him). He then (pierced) Bhimasena with ten, each of the two sons of Madri with three.

sa: अस्त्रैरस्त्राणि संवार्य द्विषतां सर्वतोविभुः। इषुभिर्बहुभिस्तूर्णं सर्वानेव समावृणोत्॥
en: Resisting with his own weapons those hurled by the foe, that highly puissant hero quickly covered all his adversaries with his myriad shafts.

sa: सौमदत्तेर्वधाद् द्रोणमायान्तं सैन्धवस्य च। अमर्षाजीवितं त्यक्त्वा गाहमानं वरुथिनीम्॥ जृम्भमाणमिव व्याघ्रं व्यात्ताननमिवान्तकम्। कथं प्रत्युद्ययुयॊणमस्यन्तं पाण्डुसृञ्जयाः॥
en: How indeed did Pandus and Srinjayas resist the striking Drona when he proceeding against them, penetrated into their host inflamed with wrath at the slaughter of Bhurisravas and Jayadratha, regardless of his very life and resembling a yawning tiger on the destroyer himself with mouth agape.

sa: ततो गाण्डीवधन्वानमब्रवीन्मधुसूदनः॥ पार्थं तथा यान्तं चिन्तापरिगतं तदा।
en: Then finding Partha proceeding in such a thoughtful mood Vasudeva's son, the slayer of Madhu, said these words to the wielder of Gandiva.

sa: वध्यमानास्तदास्त्रेण तेन नारायणेन वै। दह्यमानानलेनेव सर्वतोऽभ्यर्दिता रणे॥
en: Slaughtered by the Narayana weapon, as if burnt down by a raging fire, the troops of the Pandavas were greatly distressed in battle.

sa: तस्मिस्तु निहते वीरे विराटो रथसत्तमः। ततो विस्फार्य नयने क्रोधाद् द्विगुणविक्रमः। मद्रराजरथं तूर्णं छादयामास पत्रिभिः॥
en: The heroic (Shatanika) being slain, Virata, the chief of a great force, (abandoning his steed-less car, ascended to that (of his brother). Then, his eyes rolling (in ire) and his strength doubled with indignation, (he) quickly covered the car of the king of Madra with arrows.

sa: ततोऽपरेण भल्लेन शिरस्त्राणमपातयत्। कौन्तेयस्य महेष्वासः प्रहसन्निव सूतजः॥
en: The as if smiling the charioteer's son, a great bowman himself, struck down with another Bhalla the crown of the son of Kunti.

sa: द्रोणद्रौणिकृपैर्गुप्तो भीष्मेणान्यैश्च कौरवैः। विराटनगरे पार्थमेकं किं नावधीस्तदा॥
en: Why did you not kill Partha at Virata's city when you were protected by Drona and his son Kripa, Bhishma and other Kaurava?

sa: उदिते तु सहस्रांशौ तप्तकाञ्चनसप्रभे। प्रकाशितेषु लोकेषु पुनयुद्धमवर्तत॥
en: Upon the rise of the thousand-rayed sun of the effulgence of heated gold and upon the illumination of the world, battle raged anew.

sa: ततस्तस्मिन् परित्राणमलब्धवति फाल्गुनात्। न किंचिदनुपश्यामि जीवित स्थानमात्मनः॥
en: But he failed to have that rescue from (the clutches of) Arjuna. I too do not find any hope for my own life.

sa: ततो नृतपयः क्रुद्धाः परिवQर्धनंजयम्। क्षत्रिया बहवश्चान्ये जयद्रथवधैषिणम्॥
en: Thereafter, inflamed with rage, numerous hostile kings and various other Kshatriyas, surrounded Dhananjaya who was eager for bringing about the slaughter of Jayadratha.

sa: एकस्याप्यसमर्थस्त्वं फाल्गुनस्य रणाजिरे। कथमुत्सहसे जेतुं सकृष्णान् सर्वपाण्डवान्॥
en: You are, in battle, incapable of fighting with Phalguna alone. How can you, (therefore) hope to conquer all the Pandavas together with Krishna?

sa: बाहुभिश्चरणैच्छिन्नै: शिरोभिश्च सकुण्डलैः। कार्मुकैर्विशिखैः प्रासैः खङ्गैः परशुपट्टिशैः॥
en: With lopped-off arms and legs with heads graced with charming ear-rings, with bows and arrows and lances and swords and axes and Pattiscs.

sa: सुवर्णपुङ्खीमेन सायकैर्नतपर्वभिः। गगने रचिता माला काञ्चनीव व्यरोचत॥
en: Then with his gold-winged arrows of depressed knots, Bhima constructed a festoon in the welkin that looked like a veritable garland of gold.

sa: उपारोहदनादृत्य तस्य वीर्य महात्मनः। तयोर्विसृजतोस्तत्र शरजालानि मारिष॥
en: And totally unmindful of the latter's prowess, strove to prevail over him. O sire, those myriads of arrows, discharged by both those warriors.

sa: धृष्टधुम्नः कृपेणाथ तस्मिन् वीरवरक्षये। शिखण्डी कृतवर्माणं समासादयदच्युतम्॥
en: While that whole host of the foretnost heroes was being thus slain, Dhrishtadyumna rushed against Kripa; and that undecayable Shikhandin proceeded against Kritavarman.

sa: तलं तलेन निष्यिष्य दन्तैर्दन्तानुपास्पृशत्। निःश्वसन्नुरगो यद्वलोहिताक्षोऽभवत् तदा॥
en: Squeezing one of his hands with the other and grinding his teeth and breathing like a snake his eyes became coppery (in rage).

sa: अर्धासिभिस्तथा खड्नेस्तोमरैः सपरश्वधैः। निकृष्टयुद्धं संसक्तं महदासीत् सुदारुणम्॥
en: Then that general engagement, in which the warriors encountered one another with swords and scimitars and lances and battle, axes, became extremely terrible.

sa: ततस्तव महासैन्यं गोविन्दप्रेरिता हयाः॥ हंसवर्णाः प्रविविशुर्वहन्तः कृष्णपाण्डवौ।
en: Then those swan white horses, driven by Krishna, penetrated into your strong array bearing both Krishna and himself and the son of Pandu.

sa: सुशर्माणं सुसंक्रुद्धो जत्रुदेशे समाहनत्। तत: संशप्तकाः सर्वे परिवार्य धनंजयम्॥ शस्त्रौधैर्ममृदुः क्रुद्धा नादयन्तो दिशो दश।
en: Afterwards he, being greatly enraged, struck Susharman his shoulder-joint. Thereupon the entire army of the Samsaptakas, that became very wrathful, having surrounded Dhananjaya on all sides, crushed him with a shower of weapons and thereby caused the ten points of the horizon echo with their roars.

sa: द्रवमाणं बलं दृष्ट्वा पलायनकृतक्षणम्। दुर्योधनं समासाद्य द्रोणपुत्रोऽब्रवीदिदम्॥
en: And with difficulty extricating himself from his perilous situations, that one of the gait of an infuriated elephant, beholding the troops flying away.

sa: तांस्तु निर्जित्य समरे कर्णपुत्रोऽप्यरोचत। मध्यंदिनमनुप्राप्तो धर्मांशुरिव भारत॥
en: Having, O Bharata, defeated them in battle, the son of Karna, looked like the sun of scorching rays when he reaches the meridian.

sa: तमाजिशीर्षपायान्तं दहन्तं क्षत्रियर्षभान्। पराक्रान्तं पराक्रम्य ततः क्षत्रियपुङ्गवः॥
en: Then as that puissant one advanced at the head of battle, leaving the foremost of Kshatriyas, these last, putting forth all their prowess.

sa: ततः कर्ण समुत्सृज्य भैमसेनिरपि प्रभो। प्रत्यमित्रमुपायान्तमर्दयामास मार्गणैः॥
en: Thereupon, O lord, the son of Bhimasena also, bearing alone Karna for a while, began to afflict his advancing adversary with this shafts.

sa: एष पाण्डव ते भ्राता धार्तराष्टैर्महाबलेः। जिघांसुभिर्महेष्वासैर्वृतं पार्थोऽनुसार्यते॥
en: Behold, O son of Pandu, your brother Yudhishthira pursued by the highly powerful sons of Dhritarashtra, all great bowmen desirous of killing him.

sa: तत्र सिद्धा महाराज सम्पतन्तोऽब्रुवन् वचः॥ युद्धानामति सर्वेषां युद्धमेतदिति प्रभो। सर्वयुद्धानि चैतस्य कलां नार्हन्ति षोडशीम्॥
en: O powerful monarch, the Siddhas, who covered about there in the battle, uttered these words-'O Lord, this battle, is the foremost of all the battles fought (in the days of yore). All the battles (of old) will not be worth the sixteenth part of this (battle).

sa: स बभौ राक्षसो राजन् भिन्नाञ्जनचयोपमः। रुरोधार्जुनमायान्त प्रभञ्जनमिवाद्रिराट्॥
en: That Rakshasa, who, O monarch, looked like a loose heap of antimony, checked the Aadvancing Arjuna as the mountain Meru (resists) a hurricane.

sa: स वध्यमानो बहुभिः शरैः संनतपर्वभिः। सम्प्रायाज्जवनैरश्वैोणानीकाय सौबलः॥
en: The son of Subala, struck with numerous arrows of close knots, flew towards the division of Drona, being borne away by fleetest steeds.

sa: मत्स्यांश्चैवाजयत् कृत्स्नान् भारद्वाजो महारथान्। ततस्तु दुपदः क्रोधाच्छरवर्षमवासृजत्॥
en: That mighty car-warrior the son of Bharadvaja then also conquered the Matsyas. Thereafter Drupada, worked up with rage, poured a shower of arrows.

sa: दशमस्त्वर्जुनस्यासीदेक एव महाकपिः॥ अदीप्यतार्जुनो येन हिमवानिव वह्निना।
en: The tenth standard there, was the mighty ape belonging to Arjuna with that standard Arjuna looked like a mountain lighted up by fire.

sa: यस्मादभावी भावी वा भवेदर्थो नरं प्रति। अप्राप्तौ तस्य वा प्राप्तौ न कश्चिद् व्यथते बुधः॥
en: What is not likely to happen to man (being subject to Fate) may happen to him; or what is likely to take place may, again, happen to a person. Hence at the acquisition or nonacquisition of the purposes the learned sage should not at all grieve.

sa: तं त्वं सात्वत संत्यज्य दस्युधर्मे कथं रतः॥
en: Why, O Satvata, without observing the Kshatriya duties as formerly laid down by the gods, have you taken to the practices of robbers?

sa: ततस्ते सहिता राजन् सम्प्रधार्यासकृत प्रभुम्॥ सर्वलोकेश्वरं वाक्यं प्रणम्येदमथाब्रुवन्। अस्मभ्यं त्वं वरं देव सम्प्रयच्छ पितामह॥
en: Thereafter, O monarch, those Asuras after having brooded over the matter conjointly for a long while and settled amongst themselves and also having bowed down to that Lord of all the worlds, addressed him with these words-'O God, O grandsire, do you give us this boon.'

sa: यदि हन्याच कौन्तेयं सूतपुत्रः कथंचन। दृष्ट्वा पार्थं हि निहतं योत्स्यति केशवः॥ शङ्खचक्रगदापाणिर्धक्ष्यते तव वाहिनीम्।
en: If it be possible that the son of charioteer (Karna) should ever slay the son of Kunti, beholding the son of Pritha slaughtered, Keshava himself will surely engage in battle. And that holder of the conch, the discus and the mace will destroy your whole race.

sa: अथान्यद् धनुरादाय द्रोणपुत्रः प्रतापवान्॥ शैनेयं शरवर्षेणच्छादयामास भारत!
en: Then, O Bharata, the mighty son of Drona, taking up another bow, covered the son of Sini with quite a shower of arrows.

sa: सर्वाण्येतानि कर्माणि क्षात्रे भरतसत्तम। निराशिषो जीवलोकाः क्षत्रधर्मेऽव्यवस्थिते॥
en: All these acts, O chief of Bharatas are in Kshatriya duties. If the functions of royalty are disturbed, all creatures meet with evil.

sa: षष्टिरुष्ट्रसहस्राणि शतानि द्विगुणा हयाः। वारणाश्च महाराज सहस्रशतसम्मिताः॥
en: There were sixty thousands of camels, and a hundred and twenty thousand horses, and of elephants, O king, there were one hundred thousand.

sa: स तानतीत्य वेगेन द्रोणानीकमुपाद्रवत्। अप्रतश्च गजानीकं शरवर्षैरवाकिरत्॥
en: Covered Bhima with their arrows like the clouds covering the sun. Passing through all those divisions, Bhima then rushed against that of Drona.

sa: निपेतुर्विरदा भूमौ द्विशृङ्गा इव पर्वताः। निकृत्तैर्हस्तिहस्तैश्च चेष्टमानैरितस्ततः॥
en: The tuskers dropped (dead) on the ground like mountain peaks, with the chopped-off trunks of elephants, still moving to and fro (in convulsions).

sa: शुभ्रमत्र भवान् कृत्वा महापुरुषविग्रहम्। ईजिवांस्त्वं जपैोमैरुपहारैश्च मानद॥
en: Creating a white image of that foremost of male beings, O Bestower of honor, you adored him with homage, offerings and reiterating prayers.

sa: यदा संहरते कामान् कूर्मोऽङ्गानीव सर्वशः। तदाऽऽत्मज्योतिरात्मायमात्मन्येव प्रपश्यति॥
en: When a person withdraws all his desires like a tortoise withdrawing all its limbs, then its soul, which is self-luminous, can see itself.

sa: ऋत्विक्ष्वथ सदस्येषु स वै गृहपतिस्तदा। उपविष्टेषूपविष्टः शौनकोऽथाब्रवीदिदम्॥
en: When Shaunaka was seated in the midst of Ritviks and Sadasyas (members) who also had come to their places, Sauti spoke as follows.

sa: रणमण्डलमध्यस्थौ भ्रातरौ तौ नरर्षभौ॥ अशोभेतां महाराज चन्द्रसूर्याविवोदितौ।
en: O king! In the midst of war-field both the brothers, foremost among the men were looked like a rising moon and the sun.

sa: गालवस्तं तथेत्युक्त्वा सुपर्णसहितस्ततः। आदायाश्वांश्च कन्यां च विश्वामित्रमुपागमत्॥
en: Galava then saying to him “very well” along with Suparna, taking the horses and the maiden with him, went to Vishvamitra and said.

sa: अपारणीयं तमसः परस्तात् तदन्तकोऽप्येति विनाशकाले। अणीयो रूपं क्षुरधारया समं महच्च रूपं तद् वै पर्वतेभ्यः॥
en: Incapable of being reached by our ignorance, even the king of Death, at the time of his end, is lost in it. Its form cannot be gazed at; it is like the edge of a razor and its form is like that of a high mountain.

sa: अथापरं तपस्तप्त्वा द्विस्ततोऽन्यत् पुनर्महत्। द्यावापृथिव्योर्विवरं तेजसा समपूरयत्॥
en: Again undergoing severe austerities of another kind for twice that period, he filled the space intervening between heaven and earth with his energy.

sa: भक्ष्यानपानैर्विविधसैर्वासोभिः शयनासनैः। सर्वान् संतोषयामास संश्रितान् ददतां वरः॥
en: That foremost of charitable men satisfied all persons with presents of food and drink and dresses of various kinds and beds and seats.

sa: सोऽचितो धृतराष्ट्रेण पूजितश्च महायशाः। राजानं समनुज्ञाप्य निर्कामदरिंदमः॥
en: He, the subduer of his enemies, being worshipped and honoured by Dhritarashtra of great fame, issued out with the permission of the king.

sa: पुत्रनाशे वित्तनाशे ज्ञातिसम्बन्धिनामपि। प्राप्यते सुमहद् दुःखंदावाग्निप्रतिमं विभो।
en: Indeed, O king, upon loss of wealth or son or kinsmen or relatives, man suffers great misery burning him like a forest fire.

sa: पाण्डवाश्च महेष्वासा दूतवाक्यप्रचोदिताः। चिन्तयन्तस्तमेवार्थं नालभन्त सुखं क्वचित्॥
en: (Meanwhile) those great bowmen, the Pandavas, moved by the words of the messenger, became anxious and they did not experience the least happiness.

sa: अधिष्ठानवती लक्ष्मीः परायणवती मतिः। वर्धमानोऽखिलो धर्मस्तेनासीत् पृथिवीक्षिताम्॥
en: (During his reign) Lakshmi became stationary and hearts became devoted to the Supreme Spirit. Virtue itself began to grow all over the world.

sa: तांस्तु निष्पतितांस्रस्तान् शिविराजीवितैषिणः॥ कृतवर्मा कृपश्चैव द्वारदेशे निजघ्नतुः।
en: Those men that tried to fly away from the camp for saving their lives wee killed by Kritavarman and Kripa at the gate.

sa: एस्मिन्नन्तरे चैव प्रमत्ते सव्यसाचिनि। व्यूढानीकस्ततो द्रोणो युधिष्ठिरमुपाद्रवत्॥
en: During this period when Savyasachin was furiously engaged (with the Samshaptakas) Drona, at the head of his divisions formed in battle-array, charged Yudhishthira.

sa: अवशिष्टस्त्वमेवैकः कुलमोऽधमपूरुषः। त्वामप्यद्य हनिष्यामि गदया नात्र संशयः॥
en: You alone are still alive, O destroyer of your family, O wretch among men. I shall forsooth kill you today with my mace.

sa: आश्रमः कक्षसेनस्य पुण्यस्तत्र युधिष्ठिर। च्यवनस्याश्रमश्चैव विख्यातस्तत्र पाण्डव॥
en: O Yudhishthira, O son of Pandu, there is also the sacred hermitage of Kakshasena and also the hermitage of Chyavana known every where.

sa: किं नाम वक्ष्यत्यवनिप्रधानः पितॄन् समागम्य परत्र पापः। पुत्रेषु सम्यक् चरितं मयेति पुत्रानपापान् व्यपरोप्य राज्यात्॥
en: What will that sinful man, that ruler of earth say to his (deceased) ancestors when he will meet them in the next world? Having driven away his inoffensive sons from the throne, will he be able to say that he treated them in a blameless way?

sa: पुच्छे प्रगृह्य तरसा हीनवीर्यपराक्रमम्। सालोश्यमन्तकस्यैनं नयाम्यद्येह वानरम्॥
en: He thought, “Taking fast hold of his tale I will send this monkey destitute of energy and prowess to the abode of Yama."

sa: स्वच्छन्दमरणाश्चासन् नरा: स्वच्छन्दचारिणः। अल्पबाधा निरातङ्काः सिद्धार्था निरुपद्रवाः॥
en: They had control over their life and death, had few difficulties and no fear had all their desires gratified, were free from troubles.

sa: नभसः प्रच्युताधारास्तिग्मवीर्याः सहस्रशः। आवृण्वन् सर्वतो व्योम दिशश्चोपदिशस्तथा॥
en: Thousand of mighty torrents (of water), falling from the sky, enveloped the entire firmament and (all) the directions and the (ten) cardinal points.

sa: कर्मकाले पुनर्देहमविचिन्त्यं सृजाम्यहम्। आविश्य मानुषं देहं मर्यादाबन्धकारणात्॥
en: For the preservation of virtue and morality I assume a human form and when the times come I assumes form that are inconceivable.

sa: स च तां प्रतिजग्राह विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा। गृहीत्वा चाश्वहदयं राजन् भागासुरिर्नृपः॥ निषधाधिपतेश्चापि दत्त्वाक्षहृदयं नृपः। सूतमन्यमुपादाय ययौ स्वपुरमेव ह॥
en: O king, the royal son of Vangasura accepted that horse-learning, performing all the acts, as ordained by fate. And having thus received this horse-knowledge and also having made over his skill in the game at dice to the prince of the Nishadhas, he went to his own city, appointing another charioteer in the place of Bahuka.

sa: एतदिच्छाम्यहं त्वत्तः श्रोतुं भार्गवसत्तम। कौतूहलसमाविष्टो याथातथ्यं महामुने॥
en: O best of the Bhrigu race, O great Rishi, I desire to hear all this in detail. I am filled with great curiosity.

sa: स लाडूलरवस्तस्य मत्तवारणनि:स्वनम्। अन्तर्धाय विचित्रेषु चचार गिरिसानुषु॥
en: Rising above the roaring of mad elephants, the sounds of the lashing of his tail spread over all the slopes of the mountain.

sa: लाङ्कलास्फोटशब्दाच्च चलितः स महागिरिः। विघूर्णमानशिखरः समन्तात् पर्यशीर्यत॥
en: Shaken by the sounds produced by the lashing of his tail, the mountain, with its summits, tottered and crumbled down on all sides.

sa: संहर्षाद् धारयन् क्रोधं धन्वी स्रग्वी रथे स्थितः। समरे नाशयेच्छनमोघो नाम पावकः॥ उक्थो नाम महाभाग त्रिभिरुक्थैरभिष्टुतः। महावाचं त्वजनयत् समाश्वासं हि यं विदुः॥
en: He had another son, called Amogha, who was the destroyer of all his enemies in battle. Assured of success he controls his wrath. He is armed with a bird, he is seated on a chariot and is adorned with garlands of flowers; she had another son named Uktha, praised by the three Uktha. He is the originator of the great words (the Vedas) and he is therefore called Samasvasa.

sa: वायुश्च घूर्णते भीमस्तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्। तमुदीक्ष्य महावेगं सर्वाम्भोनिधिमुत्तमम्॥ अपश्यं दानवाकीर्णं तद् दैत्यपुरमन्तिकात्। तत्रैव मातलिस्तूर्णं निपत्य पृथिवीतले।॥
en: And a dreadful wind was sweeping over it in whirls, which appeared wonderful to me. Behoiding that excellent lord of all waters with strong tides I saw very near, the city of the Daiytas full of the Danavas. There soon entering into the nether world, Matali,

sa: गङ्गाद्वारमतिक्रम्य बहवः पर्वताः शुभाः। हिमवान् पर्वतश्चैव नानाद्विजगणायुतः॥
en: Having passed the source of the Ganges, we have seen many charming mountains and also the Himalayas, inhabited by various kinds of birds;

sa: मवेक्षमाणां कृपणान् पतीस्तान्। मुवाच दासीति हसन् सशब्दम्॥
en: Seeing Krishna (Draupadi) looking at her helpless husbands, Dushasana dragged her more forcibly and repeatedly called her "slave" "slave," and he laughed aloud.

sa: सुरम्यं कदलीषण्ड बहुयोजनविस्तृतम्। तमभ्यगच्छद् वेगेन क्षोभयिष्यन् महाबलः॥
en: A charming forest of plantain trees extending to many yojanas. The greatly powerful hero, agitating (the forest), went with great speed towards it.

sa: वाताबद्धा भवन्मेघा उपलाश्च सहस्रशः। नाशक्नुवंस्तमारोढुं विषण्णमनसो जनाः॥
en: From the wind there were created clouds and showers of thousands of stones for which the people becoming sad could not ascend it.

sa: कदाचिज्जुषते पार्थमात्मजं मातरिश्वनः। द्रौपद्याः प्रियमन्विच्छन् स बाहुबलमाश्रितः॥
en: Ever took possession of that son of Pritha and of Vayu (wind). Desiring to please Draupadi, that hero of great strength of arms,

sa: धर्मतीर्थं समासाद्य पुण्यं ब्रह्मर्षिसेवितम्। वाजपेयमवाप्नोति विमानस्थश्च पूज्यते॥
en: Going then to the sacred Dharma Tirtha, frequented by the Brahmarshis, one obtains the fruits of Vajapeya (sacrifice) and becomes adored in heaven.

sa: अथ जाम्बूनदवपुर्विमानेन महार्चिषा। कुबेरः समनुप्राप्तो यक्षैरनुगतः प्रभुः॥
en: There came also the lord Kubera, having a body resembling pure gold, seated on a highly splendid car and accompanied by numberless Yakshas.

sa: अग्निष्टोमादिभिर्यज्ञैरिष्ट्वा विपुलदक्षिणैः। न तत् फलमवाप्नोति तीर्थाभिगमनेन यत्॥
en: One does not acquire so much virtue in Agnihotra and other sacrifices full of large Dakshinas, as he acquires by visiting a Tirtha.

sa: अल्पक्षीरास्तथा गावो भविष्यन्ति जनाधिप। अल्पपुष्पफलाचापि पादपा बहुवायसाः॥
en: O ruler of men, cows yield little milk; trees are crowded with swarms of crows; they do not produce any fruits and flowers.

sa: स राजगृहमासाद्य कुबेरभवनोपमम्। अभ्यगच्छत धर्मात्मा धर्मपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम्॥
en: Coming to the royal palace which was like the palace of Kubera, the virtuous minded (Vidura) went to the son of Dharma, Yudhishthira.

sa: एतत् संयमनं पुण्यमतीवाद्भुतदर्शनम्। प्रेतराजस्य भवनमृद्ध्या परमया युतम्॥
en: This is Sanyamana, the abode of the lord of the departed souls, sacred, highly wonderful to look at and full of crowning bliss.

sa: ततो मुहूर्ताद् भगवानरावतशिरोगतः। आजगाम सहेन्द्राण्या शक्रः सुरगणैर्वृतः॥
en: Immediately came there also the great Shakra accompanied by his queen, seated on the back of Airavata and encircled by all the celestials.

sa: तच्छुभा शुभमासाद्य सौगन्धिकमनुत्तमम्। अतीव मुदिता राजन् भीमसेनमथाब्रवीत्॥
en: O king, having obtained that excellent, fragrant and blessed lotus, that blessed lady became very much delighted and she thus spoke to Bhimasena.

sa: नूनमेतत् समादातुं पुनरिच्छत्यधोक्षजः। यदस्य शिशुपालस्य तेजस्तिष्ठति भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, Krishna has been surely desirous of taking back to himself the effulgence and prowess that now lives in Shishupala.

sa: सुरकार्यार्थसिद्ध्यर्थं दृष्टवानसि शङ्करम्। अस्मत्तोऽपि गृहाण त्वमस्त्राणीति समन्ततः॥
en: You have beheld Mahadeva in order to perform the task in behalf of the celestials. Now, receive the weapons from us seated around.

sa: रुरुचर्मावृततनून् ह्रिया किंचिदवाङ्मुखान्। परैः परीतान् संहृष्टैः सुहृद्धिश्चानुशोचितान्॥
en: Their body clad in deer skins and their heads cast down. They were surrounded by rejoining foes and they were pitied by friends.

sa: ततः शक्रासने पुण्ये देवर्षिगणसेविते। शक्रः पाणौ गृहीत्वैनमुपावेशयदन्तिके॥
en: Taking him by hand Shakra made him sit on a portion of his own sacred seat resorted to by the celestials and Rishis.

sa: शीघ्रमेव गुडाकेशः कृतास्त्रः पुनरेष्यति। साक्षान्मघवता सृष्टः सम्प्राप्स्यतिधनंजयः॥
en: Having mastered the science of weapons Gudakesha will return soon, Dhananjaya, on being bidden farewell to by Maghavana himself, will meet with you.

sa: उभौ बलभृतौ वीरावुभौ तीव्रपराक्रमौ। निर्जित्याजी महाराज वङ्गराजमुपाद्रवत्॥
en: O great king, having vanquished both these heroic and greatly powerful kings, the son of Pritha (Bhima), then attacked the king of Vanga.

sa: धात्रीश्चैकैकशः प्रादात् पुत्ररक्षणतत्परः। ततः कालेन महता समुत्तस्थुर्महाबलाः॥ षष्टिः पुत्रसहस्राणि तस्याप्रतिमतेजसः। रुद्रप्रसादाद् राजर्षेः समजायन्त पार्थिव॥
en: Being anxious to save the son, he placed one nurse in charge of one vessel. Then after a long time there were born greatly powerful and exceedingly effulgent sixty thousand sons. O king, they were born to that royal sage through the favour of Rudra (Shiva).

sa: सोऽपृच्छल्लम्बमानांस्तान् भवन्त इव कम्पिताः। संतानहेतोरिति ते प्रत्यूचुर्ब्रह्मवादिनः॥
en: He asked them who were thus hanging, "What is the matter with you?" And those Brahmanas replied, “It is for the want offspring.”

sa: समर्थः स महाबाहुरेकोऽपि सुमहाबलः। देवराजमपि स्थानात् प्रच्यावयितुपञ्जसा॥ किं पुनधृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्रं दुर्दूतदेविनम्। विद्विष्टं सर्वलोकस्य दम्भमोहपरायणम्॥
en: Not to speak of the son of Dhritarashtra, that deceitful gambler, despised by all men and full of arrogance and ignorance, he (Arjuna) of mighty arms and endued with exceeding prowess is alone no doubt, capable of tearing the lord of the celestials from his throne.

sa: सापश्यद् विबुधान् सर्वानस्वेदान् स्तब्धलोचनान्। हृषितस्रग्रजोहीनान् स्थितानस्पृशतः क्षितिम्॥
en: She then beheld all the gods, not perspiring, with fixed eyes and spotless garlands (round their neck) and seated without touching the earth.

sa: इति नारायणः शम्भुर्भगवान् भूतभावनः। आदित्यविबुधान् सर्वानजायत यदुक्षये॥
en: The illustrious lord of the universe, Shambhu, Narayana, having thus commanded all the celestialss, had taken his birth in the race of Yadu.

sa: ततोऽवतीर्य वार्ष्णेयो बाहुकश्च रथोत्तमात्। हयांस्तानवमुच्याथ स्थापयामास रथम्॥
en: Thereupon Varshneya, as well as Bahuka, alighted from that excellent car; and then loosened the steeds; and at last kept the car apart.

sa: ततोऽहमिन्द्रदयितं सर्वपाषाणभेदनम्। वज्रमुद्यम्य तान् सर्वान् पर्वतान् समशातयम्॥
en: Then wielding the thunder, the favourite (weapon) of Indra, which is (ever) capable of grinding stones, I destroyed that entire mass of rocks.

sa: विदुरस्त्वथ पाण्डूनां सदा दर्शनलालसः। जगामैकरथेनैव काम्यकं वनमृद्धिमत्॥
en: Vidura, ever longing to see the Pandavas went (alone) in a single car to the forest of Kamyaka abounding in every good thing.

sa: एवमुक्तो नैषधेन मघवानभ्यभाषत। अमरान् वै निबोधास्मान् दमयन्त्यर्थमागतान्॥
en: Maghavat, being thus addressed by the king of the Nishadhas, said in reply, “Be informed that we, the celestials, come here for Damayanti.

sa: एकपक्षाक्षिचरणा वर्तिका घोरदर्शना। रक्तं वमन्ती ददृशे प्रत्यादित्यमभासुरा॥
en: And facing the sun, the ugly and dreadfullooking Vartika, having only one leg, one eye and one wing, was seen to vomit blood.

sa: विष्वगश्वः पृथोः पुत्रस्तस्मादद्रिश्च जज्ञिवान्। अद्रेश्च युवनाश्वस्तु श्रावस्तस्यात्मजोऽभवत्॥
en: Prithu had a son named Vishvagashva and Vishvagashva begot a son, named Adri. Adri had a son called Yuvanashva and Yuvanashva begot Shravasta.

sa: प्रतिग्रहादपावृत्तः संतुष्टो येन केनचित्। अहंकारनिवृत्तश्च स तीर्थफलमश्नुते॥
en: He, who has ceased to accept gifts, who is contented with little and who is free from pride, enjoys the fruits of Tirthas.

sa: अथ माहेश्वरीधारां समासाद्यधराधिप। अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति कुलं चैव समुद्धरेत्॥
en: O ruler of earth, then going to the stream, called Maheshvari, one obtains the fruits of Ashvarmedha (sacrifice) and saves his own race.

sa: वर्धमानपुद्वारदभिनिष्क्रम्य पाण्डवाः। उदङ्मुखाः शस्त्रभृतः प्रययुः सह कृष्णया॥
en: Coming out through the Vardhamana gate of the city, the Pandavas with Krishna and with their arms went away in a northerly direction.

sa: अत्रिरुवाच राजन् धन्यस्तवमीशश्च भुवि त्वं प्रथमो नृपः॥
en: Atri said : O king, you are indeed blessed, you are the lord of all beings and are the greatest sovereign on earth.

sa: चातुराश्रम्ययुक्तेन कर्मणा कालयोगिना। अकामफलसंयोगात् प्राप्नुवन्ति परां गतिम्॥
en: According to the divisions of time, they led the four modes of life without aiming at any object. Thus they obtained (final) emancipation.

sa: अहो बतायमगमः श्रीमानस्मिन् वनान्तरे। आपीडैर्बहुभिर्भाति श्रीमान् पर्वतराडिव॥
en: Oh! this charming tree in the heart of this wilderness ornamented with fruits and flowers, is shining like a glorious king of mountains.

sa: गच्छ त्वं रथमास्थाय हयैर्वातसमैर्जवे। खाण्डवप्रस्थमद्यैव समानय युधिष्ठिरम्॥
en: Go ascending a car yoked with horses possessing the speed of wind, so that you may reach Khandavaprastha day. Bring Yudhishthira with you.

sa: गमनादेव राजेन्द्र दीर्घसत्रमरिंदम्। राजसूयाश्वमेधाभ्यां फलं प्राप्नोति भारत॥
en: O king of kings, O chastiser of foes, O descendant of Bharata, going to Dirghasatra, one obtains the fruits of Rajasuya and Ashvamedha.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा मुनिश्रेष्ठं महादेवेन धीमता॥ अमुल्यग्रेण राजेन्द्र स्वङ्गुष्ठस्ताडितोऽभवत्।
en: Having said this to that best of Rishis, the highly intelligent Mahadeva struck his thumb with the end of one of his fingers.

sa: दिव्यगन्धमुपादाय ववौ पुण्यश्च मारुतः। गन्धर्वास्तुष्टुवुश्चैनं यज्वानश्च महर्षयः॥
en: Auspicious winds began to blow, carrying divine perfumes. The Gandharvas and great Rishis always engaged in the performance of sacrifices, sang his praises.

sa: पूर्वमेवाहमुक्तो वै विदुरेण महात्मना॥ दुर्योधनापराधेन प्रजेयं विनशिष्यति।
en: Long before, the high-souled Vidura had told me that through the fault of Duryodhana, the people of the Earth would be rooted out.

sa: अपश्यत महाप्राज्ञं विदुरं साश्रुलोचनम्॥ राज्ञः समीयान्निष्क्रान्तं शोकोपहतचेतसम्।
en: He then saw the highly wise Vidura sitting with tearful eyes. He had come away from Dhritarashtra, his heart possessed by great sorrow.

sa: उपवासैस्तथेज्याभिव्रतकौतुकमङ्गलैः। लभन्ते मातरो गर्भान्मासान् दश च बिभ्रति॥
en: Likewise by facts and sacrifices and vows and sacred rites and sacred ceremonies, mothers conceive. They then hold the foetus for ten months.

sa: वासुदेवस्य सांनिध्ये पार्थेनालिष्टकर्मणा। युध्यतः समरेऽन्येन प्रमत्तस्य निपातितः॥
en: In the presence of Vasudeva himself, Arjuna of pure deeds cut it off while you were heedless and engaged with another in battle.

sa: अयुद्ध्यमानस्य वधो दारामर्षः कृतघ्नता। ब्रह्मवित्तस्य चादानं निःशेषकरणं तथा॥ स्त्रिया मोषः पतिस्थानं दस्युष्वेतद् विगर्हितम्। संश्लेषं च परस्त्रीमिर्दस्युरेतानि वजयेत्॥
en: Killing a retreating enemy, ravishment of wives, ingratitude, plundering the property of a Brahmana, depriving a person of his entire property, violation of maidens, continued occupation of villages and towns as their lawful lords, and adultery with other people's wives.-these are known as sinful acts among even robbers, and robbers should always stand aloof from them.

sa: वैशालाक्षमिति प्रोक्तं तदिन्द्रः प्रत्यपद्यप्त। दशाध्यायसहस्राणि सुब्रह्मण्यो महातपाः॥
en: The abridgement, called Vaishalaksha, consisting of ten thousand chapters was then received by Indra, devoted to Brahman and possessed of great ascetic merit.

sa: तत्र चोर्मिमती राजन्नुत्पपात सरस्वती॥ तयोत्क्षिप्तः समुत्तस्थौ पूजयंस्त्रिदिवौकसः।
en: Thereat, O king, the Sarasvati. with her waves, appeared within that well. Raised above by her, Trita came up and worshipped the celestials.

sa: तं प्रेक्ष्य दीप्तं युधि माधवस्तु त्वरान्वितं सत्वरयैव लीलया। पदा विनिष्पिष्य रथोत्तमं स प्रावेशयत् पृथिवीं किंचिदेव॥ क्षितिं गता जानुभिस्तेऽथ वाहा हेमच्छन्नाश्चन्द्रमरीचिवर्णाः। ततोऽन्तिरक्षे सुमहान् निनादः सम्पूजनार्थं मधुसूदनस्य॥ दिव्यानि पुष्पाण्यथ सिंहनादाः। तस्मिस्तथा वै धरणी निमग्ने रथे प्रयत्नान्मधुसूदनस्य॥
en: Madhava, the slayer of Kansa, seeing that fiery weapon rise in the sky, with his foot quickly pressed down that beautiful car one cubit deep in the earth. The horses, white as silvery moon beams, adorned with gold trappings, with bent knees fell flat to the ground. That mighty and best of men bringing his strength into action put down the car and the horses with bent knees stretched themsclves to the earth and the car sunk into it. The heavenly creatures greatly praised Vasudeva; they gave vent to lion-like shouts and dropped flowery showers upon Krishna when the slayer of Madhu thus pressed the car into the earth by his might.

sa: ततो युधिष्ठिरस्यापि राज्ञो मङ्गलसंहिताः। उच्चेरुर्मधुरा वाचो गीतवादिनि:स्वनाः॥
en: In the mansion of King Yudhishthira also melodious voices were heard, exclaiming auspicious wishes, and the sound of songs too and musical instruments.

sa: तावुभौ पुरुषव्याघ्रौ तावुभौ धन्विनां वरौ॥ समीयतुस्तदाऽन्योन्यं परस्परवधैषिणौ।
en: Those two foremost of men both having white horses yoked to their cars quickly encountered each other, each desirous of killing the other.

sa: हैरण्यांस्त्रिनलोत्सेधान् पर्वतानेकविंशतिम्। ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददौ राजा योऽश्वमेधे महामखे॥
en: King Prithu, in one of his great Horsesacrifices, distributed amongst the Brahmanas one and twenty mountains of gold, each measuring twelve hundred cubits.

sa: अक्रोधनो महाराज तुल्यनिन्दात्मसंस्तुतिः । प्रियाप्रिये तुल्यवृत्तिर्यमवत् समदर्शन:॥
en: O monarch, censure and praise were equal to him who was without wrath, he was, like Yama himself, thoroughly impartial, treating all alike,

sa: अमोघदर्शिन् मम चेत् प्रसाद संतापदग्धस्य विभो प्रकुर्याः। सुतस्य सञ्जीवनमद्य मे स्यात् तव प्रसादात् सुतसङ्गमश्च॥
en: O you of true vision, If you, O lord, be inclined to show your grace towards this man burning for the death of his son, then that son, through your favour, is sure to be revived and to mix once more with me (in this life).

sa: तेऽवतीर्य कुरुक्षेत्र केशमज्जास्थिसंकुलम्। देहन्यासः कृतो यत्र क्षत्रियैस्तैर्महात्मभिः॥
en: They descended on that field of Kuru, which was covered with hair, marrow and bones, and where millions of great Kshatriyas had died.

sa: ततो देवनिकायास्ते नानाभूतगणास्तथा। वादयामासुरव्यग्रा भेरीः शङ्खांश्च पुष्कलान्॥
en: Then that vast host of celestials and various other creatures began cheerfully to beat their drums and blow their conchs numbering in thousands.

sa: यौवनस्थाश्च वालाश्च वृद्धाश्च जनमेजय। सहस्रशः पारिषदाः कुमारमवतस्थिरे॥
en: Some of them were young, some were old and some, O Janamejaya, were green youths. Thousands and thousands of such came to Kartikeya.

sa: रथनेमिसमुद्भूतं निःश्वासैश्चापि दन्तिनाम्। रजः संध्याभ्रकलिलं दिवाकरपथं ययौ॥
en: A dust, thick as an evening cloud, was caused in the sky by the wheels of cars and the breaths of the elephants.

sa: विष्णुरङ्गिरसे प्रादादङ्गिरा मुनिसत्तमः। प्रादादिन्द्रमरीचिभ्यां मरीचि गवे ददौ॥
en: Vishnu gave it to Angiras, and Angiras, that foremost of ascetics, handed it over to Indra and Marichi. Marichi gave it to Bhrigu.

sa: असंख्येयस्तदूर्ध्वं स्यादनादेयश्च संसदि। यस्तु धर्मविलोपेन मर्यादाभेदनेन च॥
en: Furthermore, the Kshatriya, who destroys righteousness and transgresses all wholesome restrictions, is not regarded as a Kshatriya and should be driven from society.

sa: सुधर्मा विदुरो धौम्यो धृतराष्ट्रश्च निषेदुर्व्वलनाकारेष्वासनेषु पृथक् पृथक्॥
en: Sudharman, and Vidura, and Dhaumya, and the Kuru king Dhritarashtra, each sat separately on separate seats that shone with the effulgence of fire.

sa: तृषितेन च कौन्तेय भिक्षितश्चित्रभानुना। सहस्रबाहुर्विक्रान्तः प्रादाद् भिक्षामथाग्नये॥
en: Once begged by the thirsty god of fire, O son of Kunti, the thousand-armed king of great prowess gave alms to that deity.

sa: तमेताः पर्युपासन्ते रक्ष्यमाणं महाभुजम्। सिन्धुसौवीरभर्तारं काम्बो जयवनस्त्रियः॥
en: The Kamvoja and Yavana wives of that powerful king of the Sindhus and the Sauviras are waiting upon him for protecting his body.

sa: ऋषिणोद्दालकेनापि श्वेतकेतुर्महातपाः। मिथ्या विप्रानुपचरन् संत्यक्तो दयितः सुतः॥
en: The Rishi Uddalaka renounced his favourite son Svetaketu of rigid penances, because the latter used to invite Brahmanas with false promises of entertainment.

sa: शल्यसायकनुन्नानां पाण्डवानां महामृधे। त्रातारं नाभ्यगच्छन्त केचित्तत्र महारथः॥
en: The great car-warriors among the Pandavas who were wounded in that great battle with the arrows of Shalya, could not find a protector.

sa: मृगयाक्षास्तथा पानं स्त्रियश्च भरतर्षभ। कामजान्याहुराचार्याः प्रोक्तानीह स्वयम्भुवा॥
en: The four kinds of vices begotten of lust, viz., hunting, gambling, drinking and sexual intercourse were described by the Self-sprung in that work.

sa: हतेश्वरे राजरथैः सुकल्पितैः। दे॒तं व्रजन्तो बहुधा विचूर्णिताः॥
en: Riderless cars were dragged by quickcoursing horses, men, elephants and horses fled away in no time. And the army was thus completely routed.

sa: अहो धिक्पश्य शल्यस्य पूर्णचन्द्रसुदर्शनम्। मुखं पद्मपलाशाक्षं काकैरादष्टमव्रणम्॥
en: Alas, alas, look at the smooth face of Shalya, beautiful as the moon, and having eyes resembling lotus petals, eaten away by crows.

sa: पर्जन्यमिव भूतानि महाद्रुममिव द्विजाः। नरास्तमुपजीवन्ति नृपं सर्वार्थसाधकम्॥
en: Men seek the shelter of a capable king like creatures seeking relief from the clouds or birds seeking refuge in a large tree.

sa: सोऽग्निहोत्रप्रसक्तस्य कस्यचिद् ब्रह्मवादिनः। जघानाज्ञानतः पार्थ होमधेनुं यदृच्छया।॥
en: While thus walking, O Partha, he inadvertently and unwittingly killed the Homa Cow of a certain Brahmavadin who daily performed his Agnihotra rite.

sa: गदाप्रहारा विपुलाः परिधैश्चापि ताडनम्। शक्तिभिर्भिन्दिपालैश्च तोमरैः सपरश्वधैः॥
en: You have suffered many blows of the mace, and many strokes of spiked bludgeons and dart and short arrows and lances and battle-axes.

sa: बहवश्च गतप्राणाः क्षत्रिया जयगृद्धिनः। भूमावभ्यपतन् राजन् शरवृष्टिभिरावृताः॥
en: O king, actuated with the desire of victory, large numbers of Kshatriyas were struck down with arrows and lay prostrate on the earth.

sa: अमर्षवशमापन्नान् दुर्योधनवशे स्थितान्। पश्येमान् पुरुषव्याघ्रान् संशान्तान् पावकानिव॥
en: There, those foremost of men, who fought on Duryodhana's side, and went to the field in anger and now lying like extinguished fires.

sa: कर्माण्यकुहकार्थानि येषां वाचश्च सूनृताः। येषामाश्च सम्बद्धा दुर्गाण्यतितरन्ति॥
en: Those who never act deceitfully, whose words are always sweet and whose wealth is always well spent, succeed in getting over all difficulties.
